quotes.quote: Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
quotes.author: Winston S. Churchill

quotes.quote: What is success? I think it is a mixture of having a flair for the thing that you are doing; knowing that it is not enough, that you have got to have hard work and a certain sense of purpose.
quotes.author: Margaret Thatcher

quotes.quote: If everyone is moving forward together, then success takes care of itself.
quotes.author: Henry Ford

quotes.quote: He has achieved success who has worked well, laughed often, and loved much.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: Success makes so many people hate you. I wish it wasn't that way. It would be wonderful to enjoy success without seeing envy in the eyes of those around you.
quotes.author: Marilyn Monroe

quotes.quote: Success comes from knowing that you did your best to become the best that you are capable of becoming.
quotes.author: John Wooden

quotes.quote: The most important single ingredient in the formula of success is knowing how to get along with people.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt

quotes.quote: It had long since come to my attention that people of accomplishment rarely sat back and let things happen to them. They went out and happened to things.
quotes.author: Leonardo da Vinci

quotes.quote: Always bear in mind that your own resolution to succeed is more important than any other.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: Seventy percent of success in life is showing up.
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: You don't have to be a genius or a visionary or even a college graduate to be successful. You just need a framework and a dream.
quotes.author: Michael Dell

quotes.quote: Success isn't measured by money or power or social rank. Success is measured by your discipline and inner peace.
quotes.author: Mike Ditka

quotes.quote: What's money? A man is a success if he gets up in the morning and goes to bed at night and in between does what he wants to do.
quotes.author: Bob Dylan

quotes.quote: To be successful, you have to have your heart in your business and your business in your heart.
quotes.author: Thomas J. Watson

quotes.quote: The greatest trap in our life is not success, popularity or power, but self-rejection.
quotes.author: Henri Nouwen

quotes.quote: The size of your success is measured by the strength of your desire; the size of your dream; and how you handle disappointment along the way.
quotes.author: Robert Kiyosaki

quotes.quote: If you want to be truly successful invest in yourself to get the knowledge you need to find your unique factor. When you find it and focus on it and persevere your success will blossom.
quotes.author: Sydney Madwed

quotes.quote: Formal education will make you a living; self-education will make you a fortune.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.quote: Think twice before you speak, because your words and influence will plant the seed of either success or failure in the mind of another.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill

quotes.quote: In order to attain the impossible, one must attempt the absurd.
quotes.author: Miguel de Cervantes

quotes.quote: Success depends upon previous preparation, and without such preparation there is sure to be failure.
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.quote: Success is finding satisfaction in giving a little more than you take.
quotes.author: Christopher Reeve

quotes.quote: The secrets of success are a good wife and a steady job. My wife told me.
quotes.author: Howard Nemerov

quotes.quote: Frustration, although quite painful at times, is a very positive and essential part of success.
quotes.author: Bo Bennett

quotes.quote: Formula for success: rise early, work hard, strike oil.
quotes.author: J. Paul Getty

quotes.quote: The greatest sign of success for a teacher... is to be able to say, 'The children are now working as if I did not exist.'
quotes.author: Maria Montessori

quotes.quote: Success is peace of mind which is a direct result of self-satisfaction in knowing you did your best to become the best you are capable of becoming.
quotes.author: John Wooden

quotes.quote: Coming together is a beginning; keeping together is progress; working together is success.
quotes.author: Henry Ford

quotes.quote: The price of success is hard work, dedication to the job at hand, and the determination that whether we win or lose, we have applied the best of ourselves to the task at hand.
quotes.author: Vince Lombardi

quotes.quote: Success is simple. Do what's right, the right way, at the right time.
quotes.author: Arnold H. Glasow

quotes.quote: The starting point of all achievement is desire.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill

quotes.quote: Always be yourself, express yourself, have faith in yourself, do not go out and look for a successful personality and duplicate it.
quotes.author: Bruce Lee

quotes.quote: Success consists of going from failure to failure without loss of enthusiasm.
quotes.author: Winston Churchill

quotes.quote: Success is nothing more than a few simple disciplines, practiced every day.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.quote: Try not to become a man of success, but rather try to become a man of value.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Action is the foundational key to all success.
quotes.author: Pablo Picasso

quotes.quote: A successful man is one who can lay a firm foundation with the bricks others have thrown at him.
quotes.author: David Brinkley

quotes.quote: Winning isn't everything, it's the only thing.
quotes.author: Vince Lombardi

quotes.quote: Success is how high you bounce when you hit bottom.
quotes.author: George S. Patton

quotes.quote: Happiness lies in the joy of achievement and the thrill of creative effort.
quotes.author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

quotes.quote: No man succeeds without a good woman behind him. Wife or mother, if it is both, he is twice blessed indeed.
quotes.author: Godfrey Winn

quotes.quote: Success is a lousy teacher. It seduces smart people into thinking they can't lose.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: It is no use saying, 'We are doing our best.' You have got to succeed in doing what is necessary.
quotes.author: Winston Churchill

quotes.quote: Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: I think that success is having fun.
quotes.author: Bruno Mars

quotes.quote: As I've progressed in my career, I've come to appreciate - and really value - the other attributes that define a company's success beyond the P&L: great leadership, long-term financial strength, ethical business practices, evolving business strategies, sound governance, powerful brands, values-based decision-making.
quotes.author: Ursula Burns

quotes.quote: Success is not only one thing. It's not only having a nice house in Beverly Hills and driving a nice Mercedes.
quotes.author: Malik Bendjelloul

quotes.quote: I don't know the key to success, but the key to failure is trying to please everybody.
quotes.author: Bill Cosby

quotes.quote: I believe that being successful means having a balance of success stories across the many areas of your life. You can't truly be considered successful in your business life if your home life is in shambles.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.quote: Basically, when you get to my age, you'll really measure your success in life by how many of the people you want to have love you actually do love you.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett

quotes.quote: The talent of success is nothing more than doing what you can do well, and doing well whatever you do without thought of fame. If it comes at all it will come because it is deserved, not because it is sought after.
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.quote: I think I've always been somebody, since the deaths of my father and brother, who was afraid to hope. So, I was more prepared for failure and for rejection than for success.
quotes.author: Amy Tan

quotes.quote: My success was due to good luck, hard work, and support and advice from friends and mentors. But most importantly, it depended on me to keep trying after I had failed.
quotes.author: Mark Warner

quotes.quote: I believe that one key to success is to accept truth, no matter how it's spoken.
quotes.author: Robert Kiyosaki

quotes.quote: Achievement is not always success, while reputed failure often is. It is honest endeavor, persistent effort to do the best possible under any and all circumstances.
quotes.author: Orison Swett Marden

quotes.quote: Adjusting to the passage of time, I think, is a key to success and to life: just being able to roll with the punches.
quotes.author: Dolly Parton

quotes.quote: My songs are the door to every dream I've ever had and every success I've ever achieved.
quotes.author: Dolly Parton

quotes.quote: The most successful men in the end are those whose success is the result of steady accretion.
quotes.author: Alexander Graham Bell

quotes.quote: I've been so fortunate in my life that my family has never been jealous of my success. They have shown true love and commitment to me by being supportive. They shared in it.
quotes.author: Mike Krzyzewski

quotes.quote: No matter how much success you're having, you can't continue working together if you can't communicate.
quotes.author: Matt Cameron

quotes.quote: That should be the measure of success for everyone. It's not money, it's not fame, it's not celebrity; my index of success is happiness.
quotes.author: Lupe Fiasco

quotes.quote: Divorce is never a pleasant experience. You look upon it as a failure. But I learned to be a different person once we broke up. Sometimes you learn more from failure than you do from success.
quotes.author: Michael Crawford

quotes.quote: There's a misconception that survival of the fittest means survival of the most aggressive. The adjective 'Darwinian' used to refer to ruthless competition; you used to read that in business journals. But that's not what Darwinian means to a biologist; it's whatever leads to reproductive success.
quotes.author: Steven Pinker

quotes.quote: The successful man doesn't use others, other people use the successful man, for above all the success is of service.
quotes.author: Mark Caine

quotes.quote: I think there are those individuals who are intimidated by really smart, talented people. But for me, surrounding yourself with great talent is the key to success.
quotes.author: Monika Chiang

quotes.quote: Written in 1895, Alfred Nobel's will endowed prizes for scientific research in chemistry, physics, and medicine. At that time, these fields were narrowly defined, and researchers were often classically trained in only one discipline. In the late 19th century, knowledge of science was not a requisite for success in other walks of life.
quotes.author: Peter Agre

quotes.quote: When I was 4 years old, my brother and sister died of hunger, so I achieved my success through confidence, self-motivation and my hard work.
quotes.author: Chen Guangbiao

quotes.quote: My father left Nazi Germany a year after Dr. Kissinger, and so in my household he was very much an icon. He was a kind of immigrant success story, a refugee success story.
quotes.author: Eugene Jarecki

quotes.quote: The Nationals tried hard to recover the lost ground. The final result, however, was the success of the Forest Citys by a score of 29 to 23 in a nine innings game, twice interrupted by rain.
quotes.author: Henry Chadwick

quotes.quote: Obstacles are necessary for success because in selling, as in all careers of importance, victory comes only after many struggles and countless defeats.
quotes.author: Og Mandino

quotes.quote: Sound character provides the power with which a person may ride the emergencies of life instead of being overwhelmed by them. Failure is... the highway to success.
quotes.author: Og Mandino

quotes.quote: Success has a simple formula: do your best, and people may like it.
quotes.author: Sam Ewing

quotes.quote: Success - keeping your mind awake and your desire asleep.
quotes.author: Walter Scott

quotes.quote: Success is sweet and sweeter if long delayed and gotten through many struggles and defeats.
quotes.author: Amos Bronson Alcott

quotes.quote: Success breeds success.
quotes.author: Mia Hamm

quotes.quote: Success is not measured by what you accomplish, but by the opposition you have encountered, and the courage with which you have maintained the struggle against overwhelming odds.
quotes.author: Orison Swett Marden

quotes.quote: Man needs his difficulties because they are necessary to enjoy success.
quotes.author: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

quotes.quote: Most people give up just when they're about to achieve success. They quit on the one yard line. They give up at the last minute of the game one foot from a winning touchdown.
quotes.author: Ross Perot

quotes.quote: The thermometer of success is merely the jealousy of the malcontents.
quotes.author: Salvador Dali

quotes.quote: Success is counted sweetest by those who never succeed.
quotes.author: Emily Dickinson

quotes.quote: A champion is afraid of losing. Everyone else is afraid of winning.
quotes.author: Billie Jean King

quotes.quote: Do you wish to rise? Begin by descending. You plan a tower that will pierce the clouds? Lay first the foundation of humility.
quotes.author: Saint Augustine

quotes.quote: Success is the child of drudgery and perseverance. It cannot be coaxed or bribed; pay the price and it is yours.
quotes.author: Orison Swett Marden

quotes.quote: I honestly think it is better to be a failure at something you love than to be a success at something you hate.
quotes.author: George Burns

quotes.quote: The toughest thing about success is that you've got to keep on being a success.
quotes.author: Irving Berlin

quotes.quote: Success is like reaching an important birthday and finding you're exactly the same.
quotes.author: Audrey Hepburn

quotes.quote: Once you agree upon the price you and your family must pay for success, it enables you to ignore the minor hurts, the opponent's pressure, and the temporary failures.
quotes.author: Vince Lombardi

quotes.quote: The measure of success is not whether you have a tough problem to deal with, but whether it is the same problem you had last year.
quotes.author: John Foster Dulles

quotes.quote: In this world it is not what we take up, but what we give up, that makes us rich.
quotes.author: Henry Ward Beecher

quotes.quote: Success is that old ABC - ability, breaks, and courage.
quotes.author: Charles Luckman

quotes.quote: Success isn't everything but it makes a man stand straight.
quotes.author: Lillian Hellman

quotes.quote: The love of what you do, combined with your belief in what you do, will not determine your success. It will determine how hard you will work and how dedicated you will be to achieving it. Success just shows up from there.
quotes.author: Jeffrey Gitomer

quotes.quote: The difference between a successful person and others is not a lack of strength, not a lack of knowledge, but rather a lack of will.
quotes.author: Vince Lombardi

quotes.quote: The real secret of success is enthusiasm.
quotes.author: Walter Chrysler

quotes.quote: The ladder of success is best climbed by stepping on the rungs of opportunity.
quotes.author: Ayn Rand

quotes.quote: Success is a science; if you have the conditions, you get the result.
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Defeat is not the worst of failures. Not to have tried is the true failure.
quotes.author: George Edward Woodberry

quotes.quote: One secret of success in life is for a man to be ready for his opportunity when it comes.
quotes.author: Benjamin Disraeli

quotes.quote: In all our deeds, the proper value and respect for time determines success or failure.
quotes.author: Malcolm X

quotes.quote: Have regular hours for work and play; make each day both useful and pleasant, and prove that you understand the worth of time by employing it well. Then youth will be delightful, old age will bring few regrets, and life will become a beautiful success.
quotes.author: Louisa May Alcott

quotes.quote: Always remember that striving and struggle precede success, even in the dictionary.
quotes.author: Sarah Ban Breathnach

quotes.quote: I have no problem with the people who work hard to get success. But I think people are very jealous about success. I work very hard and they don't appreciate that.
quotes.author: Alain Prost

quotes.quote: You can be discouraged by failure, or you can learn from it. So go ahead and make mistakes, make all you can. Because, remember that's where you'll find success - on the far side of failure.
quotes.author: Thomas J. Watson

quotes.quote: As you walk in God's divine wisdom, you will surely begin to see a greater measure of victory and good success in your life.
quotes.author: Joseph Prince

quotes.quote: Growing up in a group home, and with an undiagnosed learning disability to boot, the odds of success were not on my side. But when I joined the high school football team, I learned the value of discipline, focus, persistence, and teamwork - all skills that have proven vital to my career as a C.E.O. and social entrepreneur.
quotes.author: Darell Hammond

quotes.quote: I have a tendency to sabotage relationships; I have a tendency to sabotage everything. Fear of success, fear of failure, fear of being afraid. Useless, good-for-nothing thoughts.
quotes.author: Michael Buble

quotes.quote: A little more persistence, a little more effort, and what seemed hopeless failure may turn to glorious success.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: I'd rather invest in an entrepreneur who has failed before than one who assumes success from day one.
quotes.author: Kevin O'Leary

quotes.quote: The hardest thing to find in life is balance - especially the more success you have, the more you look to the other side of the gate. What do I need to stay grounded, in touch, in love, connected, emotionally balanced? Look within yourself.
quotes.author: Celine Dion

quotes.quote: A tragic irony of life is that we so often achieve success or financial independence after the chief reason for which we sought it has passed away.
quotes.author: Ellen Glasgow

quotes.quote: A key to achieving success is to assemble a strong and stable management team.
quotes.author: Vivek Wadhwa

quotes.quote: Some might complain that nuclear disarmament is little more than a dream. But that ignores the very tangible benefits disarmament would bring for all humankind. Its success would strengthen international peace and security. It would free up vast and much-needed resources for social and economic development. It would advance the rule of law.
quotes.author: Ban Ki-moon

quotes.quote: My success set me up for life, and it meant that I could retire from the music industry at 27 to spend time with my newborn daughter and my wife. My time away from the spotlight allowed me to rediscover my love for music, and I'm doing it for me now and no one else.
quotes.author: Rick Astley

quotes.quote: Good ideas are like Nike sports shoes. They may facilitate success for an athlete who possesses them, but on their own they are nothing but an overpriced pair of sneakers. Sports shoes don't win races. Athletes do.
quotes.author: Felix Dennis

quotes.quote: Success is the sum of details.
quotes.author: Harvey S. Firestone

quotes.quote: One press account said I was an overnight success. I thought that was the longest night I've ever spent.
quotes.author: Sandra Cisneros

quotes.quote: It's a special person - and personality - who can lead a start-up to soaring success and sustain that success for the long term. Apple co-founder Steve Jobs and Facebook's Mark Zuckerberg are star examples.
quotes.author: Marcus Buckingham

quotes.quote: Indomitable perseverance in a business, properly understood, always ensures ultimate success.
quotes.author: Cyrus McCormick

quotes.quote: Money and success don't change people; they merely amplify what is already there.
quotes.author: Will Smith

quotes.quote: The season of failure is the best time for sowing the seeds of success.
quotes.author: Paramahansa Yogananda

quotes.quote: The battle of life is, in most cases, fought uphill; and to win it without a struggle were perhaps to win it without honor. If there were no difficulties there would be no success; if there were nothing to struggle for, there would be nothing to be achieved.
quotes.author: Samuel Smiles

quotes.quote: Any fact facing us is not as important as our attitude toward it, for that determines our success or failure. The way you think about a fact may defeat you before you ever do anything about it. You are overcome by the fact because you think you are.
quotes.author: Norman Vincent Peale

quotes.quote: Success in its highest and noblest form calls for peace of mind and enjoyment and happiness which come only to the man who has found the work that he likes best.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill

quotes.quote: Life is a series of punches. It presents a lot of challenges. It presents a lot of hardship, but the people that are able to take those punches and able to move forward are the ones that really do have a lot of success and have a lot of joy in their life and have a lot of stories to tell, too.
quotes.author: Josh Turner

quotes.quote: The only thing I'm addicted to is winning. This bootleg cult, arrogantly referred to as Alcoholics Anonymous, reports a 5 percent success rate. My success rate is 100 percent.
quotes.author: Charlie Sheen

quotes.quote: When humor can be made to alternate with melancholy, one has a success, but when the same things are funny and melancholic at the same time, it's just wonderful.
quotes.author: Francois Truffaut

quotes.quote: A great social success is a pretty girl who plays her cards as carefully as if she were plain.
quotes.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

quotes.quote: Eighty percent of success is showing up.
quotes.author: Woody Allen

quotes.quote: I was obliged to be industrious. Whoever is equally industrious will succeed equally well.
quotes.author: Johann Sebastian Bach

quotes.quote: Flaming enthusiasm, backed up by horse sense and persistence, is the quality that most frequently makes for success.
quotes.author: Dale Carnegie

quotes.quote: It's the steady, quiet, plodding ones who win in the lifelong race.
quotes.author: Robert W. Service

quotes.quote: A person with a new idea is a crank until the idea succeeds.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: Success in almost any field depends more on energy and drive than it does on intelligence. This explains why we have so many stupid leaders.
quotes.author: Sloan Wilson

quotes.quote: When you win, nothing hurts.
quotes.author: Joe Namath

quotes.quote: The man who has done his level best... is a success, even though the world may write him down a failure.
quotes.author: B. C. Forbes

quotes.quote: To be prepared is half the victory.
quotes.author: Miguel de Cervantes

quotes.quote: Success is getting what you want. Happiness is wanting what you get.
quotes.author: Dale Carnegie

quotes.quote: As kids we're not taught how to deal with success; we're taught how to deal with failure. If at first you don't succeed, try, try again. If at first you succeed, then what?
quotes.author: Charlie Sheen

quotes.quote: Success is dependent on effort.
quotes.author: Sophocles

quotes.quote: Let me tell you the secret that has led me to my goal. My strength lies solely in my tenacity.
quotes.author: Louis Pasteur

quotes.quote: One fails forward toward success.
quotes.author: Charles Kettering

quotes.quote: Do something you really like, and hopefully it pays the rent. As far as I'm concerned, that's success.
quotes.author: Tom Petty

quotes.quote: To be successful you have to be lucky, or a little mad, or very talented, or find yourself in a rapid growth field.
quotes.author: Edward de Bono

quotes.quote: Success is often the result of taking a misstep in the right direction.
quotes.author: Al Bernstein

quotes.quote: Belief in oneself is one of the most important bricks in building any successful venture.
quotes.author: Lydia M. Child

quotes.quote: Success is falling nine times and getting up ten.
quotes.author: Jon Bon Jovi

quotes.quote: Part of the secret of a success in life is to eat what you like and let the food fight it out inside.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: The secret of success is to be in harmony with existence, to be always calm to let each wave of life wash us a little farther up the shore.
quotes.author: Cyril Connolly

quotes.quote: If at first you don't succeed, try, try again. Then quit. There's no point in being a damn fool about it.
quotes.author: W. C. Fields

quotes.quote: The successful man will profit from his mistakes and try again in a different way.
quotes.author: Dale Carnegie

quotes.quote: Success isn't a result of spontaneous combustion. You must set yourself on fire.
quotes.author: Arnold H. Glasow

quotes.quote: An artist cannot fail; it is a success to be one.
quotes.author: Charles Horton Cooley

quotes.quote: The common idea that success spoils people by making them vain, egotistic and self-complacent is erroneous; on the contrary it makes them, for the most part, humble, tolerant and kind.
quotes.author: W. Somerset Maugham

quotes.quote: They succeed, because they think they can.
quotes.author: Virgil

quotes.quote: I'm happy to be on a winning team. My individual success, that lasts for a short period of time. The success of being a part of the South, of Atlanta, which is now the hot bed of music, that's what's gonna last the longest. The fact that I contributed to planting our flag and moving music to my city, that's what I'm most proud of.
quotes.author: T.I.

quotes.quote: Four things for success: work and pray, think and believe.
quotes.author: Norman Vincent Peale

quotes.quote: A desire to be in charge of our own lives, a need for control, is born in each of us. It is essential to our mental health, and our success, that we take control.
quotes.author: Robert Foster Bennett

quotes.quote: You stand with the least likely to succeed until success is succeeded by something more valuable: kinship. You stand with the belligerent, the surly and the badly behaved until bad behavior is recognized for the language it is: the vocabulary of the deeply wounded and of those whose burdens are more than they can bear.
quotes.author: Greg Boyle

quotes.quote: Men of age object too much, consult too long, adventure too little, repent too soon, and seldom drive business home to the full period, but content themselves with a mediocrity of success.
quotes.author: Dale Carnegie

quotes.quote: Passion is what gives meaning to our lives. It's what allows us to achieve success beyond our wildest imagination. Try to find a career path that you have a passion for.
quotes.author: Henry Samueli

quotes.quote: To measure the success of our societies, we should examine how well those with different abilities, including persons with autism, are integrated as full and valued members.
quotes.author: Ban Ki-moon

quotes.quote: I am an enthusiast, but not a crank in the sense that I have some pet theories as to the proper construction of a flying machine. I wish to avail myself of all that is already known and then, if possible, add my mite to help on the future worker who will attain final success.
quotes.author: Wilbur Wright

quotes.quote: I have had all of the disadvantages required for success.
quotes.author: Larry Ellison

quotes.quote: You cannot climb the ladder of success dressed in the costume of failure.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.quote: People with a sense of humor tend to be less egocentric and more realistic in their view of the world and more humble in moments of success and less defeated in times of travail.
quotes.author: Bob Newhart

quotes.quote: We were all born with a certain degree of power. The key to success is discovering this innate power and using it daily to deal with whatever challenges come our way.
quotes.author: Les Brown

quotes.quote: Success comes to those who dedicate everything to their passion in life. To be successful, it is also very important to be humble and never let fame or money travel to your head.
quotes.author: A. R. Rahman

quotes.quote: Success is never final, failure is never fatal. It's courage that counts.
quotes.author: John Wooden

quotes.quote: Ambition is the path to success. Persistence is the vehicle you arrive in.
quotes.author: Bill Bradley

quotes.quote: Albert Camus, a great humanist and existentialist voice, pointed out that to commit to a just cause with no hope of success is absurd. But then, he also noted that not committing to a just cause is equally absurd. But only one choice offers the possibility for dignity. And dignity matters. Dignity matters.
quotes.author: David Simon

quotes.quote: The road to success is always under construction.
quotes.author: Arnold Palmer

quotes.quote: Learning and innovation go hand in hand. The arrogance of success is to think that what you did yesterday will be sufficient for tomorrow.
quotes.author: William Pollard

quotes.quote: Success is the sum of small efforts - repeated day in and day out.
quotes.author: Robert Collier

quotes.quote: Successful people make money. It's not that people who make money become successful, but that successful people attract money. They bring success to what they do.
quotes.author: Wayne Dyer

quotes.quote: Our success educationally, industrially and politically is based upon the protection of a nation founded by ourselves. And the nation can be nowhere else but in Africa.
quotes.author: Marcus Garvey

quotes.quote: Never continue in a job you don't enjoy. If you're happy in what you're doing, you'll like yourself, you'll have inner peace. And if you have that, along with physical health, you will have had more success than you could possibly have imagined.
quotes.author: Johnny Carson

quotes.quote: I'm an addict, I'm addicted to success. Thankfully, there's no rehab for success.
quotes.author: Lil Wayne

quotes.quote: The secret of your success is determined by your daily agenda.
quotes.author: John C. Maxwell

quotes.quote: Part of being a man is learning to take responsibility for your successes and for your failures. You can't go blaming others or being jealous. Seeing somebody else's success as your failure is a cancerous way to live.
quotes.author: Kevin Bacon

quotes.quote: Challenge is the pathway to engagement and progress in our lives. But not all challenges are created equal. Some challenges make us feel alive, engaged, connected, and fulfilled. Others simply overwhelm us. Knowing the difference as you set bigger and bolder challenges for yourself is critical to your sanity, success, and satisfaction.
quotes.author: Brendon Burchard

quotes.quote: No one succeeds without effort... Those who succeed owe their success to perseverance.
quotes.author: Ramana Maharshi

quotes.quote: My powers are ordinary. Only my application brings me success.
quotes.author: Isaac Newton

quotes.quote: Success is achieved and maintained by those who try and keep trying.
quotes.author: W. Clement Stone

quotes.quote: The secret of success is sincerity.
quotes.author: Jean Giraudoux

quotes.quote: Failure is success if we learn from it.
quotes.author: Malcolm Forbes

quotes.quote: It's our nature: Human beings like success but they hate successful people.
quotes.author: Carrot Top

quotes.quote: All men's gains are the fruit of venturing.
quotes.author: Herodotus

quotes.quote: Sometimes I worry about being a success in a mediocre world.
quotes.author: Lily Tomlin

quotes.quote: It's not enough that I should succeed - others should fail.
quotes.author: David Merrick

quotes.quote: The one phrase you can use is that success has a thousand fathers, and failure is an orphan.
quotes.author: Alan Price

quotes.quote: Obedience is the mother of success and is wedded to safety.
quotes.author: Aeschylus

quotes.quote: The one thing that I know is that you win with good people.
quotes.author: Don Shula

quotes.quote: The victor belongs to the spoils.
quotes.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

quotes.quote: I'm hopeful. I know there is a lot of ambition in Washington, obviously. But I hope the ambitious realize that they are more likely to succeed with success as opposed to failure.
quotes.author: George W. Bush

quotes.quote: Success is the progressive realization of predetermined, worthwhile, personal goals.
quotes.author: Paul J. Meyer

quotes.quote: Whatever success I may have attained is due to the fact that since I was old enough to work at all, my ambition has never deserted me.
quotes.author: Anna Held

quotes.quote: Success seems to be largely a matter of hanging on after others have let go.
quotes.author: William Feather

quotes.quote: There is no substitute for victory.
quotes.author: Douglas MacArthur

quotes.quote: How can they say my life is not a success? Have I not for more than sixty years got enough to eat and escaped being eaten?
quotes.author: Logan Pearsall Smith

quotes.quote: Diligence is the mother of good fortune.
quotes.author: Benjamin Disraeli

quotes.quote: In order to succeed you must fail, so that you know what not to do the next time.
quotes.author: Anthony J. D'Angelo

quotes.quote: Don't confuse fame with success. Madonna is one; Helen Keller is the other.
quotes.author: Erma Bombeck

quotes.quote: Can you imagine what I would do if I could do all I can?
quotes.author: Jeff Rich

quotes.quote: Success is the one unpardonable sin against our fellows.
quotes.author: Ambrose Bierce

quotes.quote: Those who have succeeded at anything and don't mention luck are kidding themselves.
quotes.author: Larry King

quotes.quote: Success is no accident. It is hard work, perseverance, learning, studying, sacrifice and most of all, love of what you are doing or learning to do.
quotes.author: Pele

quotes.quote: After I won the Oscar, my salary doubled, my friends tripled, my children became more popular at school, my butcher made a pass at me, and my maid hit me up for a raise.
quotes.author: Shirley Jones

quotes.quote: Nothing succeeds like success.
quotes.author: Alexandre Dumas

quotes.quote: I can't imagine a person becoming a success who doesn't give this game of life everything he's got.
quotes.author: Walter Cronkite

quotes.quote: I don't think about financial success as the measurement of my success.
quotes.author: Christie Hefner

quotes.quote: To know even one life has breathed easier because you have lived. This is to have succeeded.
quotes.author: Bessie Anderson Stanley

quotes.quote: Success is simply a matter of luck. Ask any failure.
quotes.author: Earl Wilson

quotes.quote: Success is a state of mind. If you want success, start thinking of yourself as a success.
quotes.author: Joyce Brothers

quotes.quote: We should measure welfare's success by how many people leave welfare, not by how many are added.
quotes.author: Ronald Reagan

quotes.quote: Victory has a thousand fathers, but defeat is an orphan.
quotes.author: John F. Kennedy

quotes.quote: Success is blocked by concentrating on it and planning for it... Success is shy - it won't come out while you're watching.
quotes.author: Tennessee Williams

quotes.quote: Whosoever desires constant success must change his conduct with the times.
quotes.author: Niccolo Machiavelli

quotes.quote: In a balanced organization, working towards a common objective, there is success.
quotes.author: Arthur Helps

quotes.quote: Much effort, much prosperity.
quotes.author: Euripides

quotes.quote: I can't give you a sure-fire formula for success, but I can give you a formula for failure: try to please everybody all the time.
quotes.author: Herbert Bayard Swope

quotes.quote: Definiteness of purpose is the starting point of all achievement.
quotes.author: W. Clement Stone

quotes.quote: People think that at the top there isn't much room. They tend to think of it as an Everest. My message is that there is tons of room at the top.
quotes.author: Margaret Thatcher

quotes.quote: If you find it in your heart to care for somebody else, you will have succeeded.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: Success or failure depends more upon attitude than upon capacity successful men act as though they have accomplished or are enjoying something. Soon it becomes a reality. Act, look, feel successful, conduct yourself accordingly, and you will be amazed at the positive results.
quotes.author: William James

quotes.quote: I have learned that success is to be measured not so much by the position that one has reached in life as by the obstacles which he has had to overcome while trying to succeed.
quotes.author: Booker T. Washington

quotes.quote: Failure is not an option. Everyone has to succeed.
quotes.author: Arnold Schwarzenegger

quotes.quote: There is no success without hardship.
quotes.author: Sophocles

quotes.quote: There is only one success - to be able to spend your life in your own way.
quotes.author: Christopher Morley

quotes.quote: If you have no critics you'll likely have no success.
quotes.author: Malcolm X

quotes.quote: Success is not forever and failure isn't fatal.
quotes.author: Don Shula

quotes.quote: God lets you be successful because he trusts you that you will do the right thing with it. Now, does he get disappointed often? All the time, because people get there and they forget how they got it.
quotes.author: Steve Harvey

quotes.quote: Success is not a good teacher, failure makes you humble.
quotes.author: Shah Rukh Khan

quotes.quote: The five essential entrepreneurial skills for success: Concentration, Discrimination, Organization, Innovation and Communication.
quotes.author: Harold S. Geneen

quotes.quote: Winning isn't everything, but it beats anything in second place.
quotes.author: William C. Bryant

quotes.quote: Develop success from failures. Discouragement and failure are two of the surest stepping stones to success.
quotes.author: Dale Carnegie

quotes.quote: The secret of my success is a two word answer: Know people.
quotes.author: Harvey S. Firestone

quotes.quote: There is little success where there is little laughter.
quotes.author: Andrew Carnegie

quotes.quote: Success comes to a writer as a rule, so gradually that it is always something of a shock to him to look back and realize the heights to which he has climbed.
quotes.author: P. G. Wodehouse

quotes.quote: I don't measure my success anymore by the Grammys. I can't because I'll just end up crushed.
quotes.author: Drake

quotes.quote: Apple Computer would not have reached its current peak of success if it had feared to roll the dice and launch products that didn't always hit the mark. In the mid-1990s, the company was considered washed up, Steve Jobs had departed, and a string of lackluster product launches unrelated to the company's core business.
quotes.author: Naveen Jain

quotes.quote: Work/life benefits allow companies meaningful ways for responding to their employees' needs; they can be a powerful tool for transforming a workforce and driving a business' success.
quotes.author: Anne M. Mulcahy

quotes.quote: Our safety at home and the cause of freedom abroad is largely contingent upon our success in Iraq.
quotes.author: Ron Lewis

quotes.quote: Men judge us by the success of our efforts. God looks at the efforts themselves.
quotes.author: Charlotte Bronte

quotes.quote: There's a lot of blood, sweat, and guts between dreams and success.
quotes.author: Paul Bryant

quotes.quote: Success is different for everyone; everybody defines it in their own way, and that's part of what we do in 'Close Up', finding what it was each person wanted to achieve and what their willingness to sacrifice for that was.
quotes.author: William Shatner

quotes.quote: I believe success is preparation, because opportunity is going to knock on your door sooner or later but are you prepared to answer that?
quotes.author: Omar Epps

quotes.quote: As an outside; don't worry about failure, because failure will take care of itself. Focus on success.
quotes.author: Henry Cavill

quotes.quote: Past performance speaks a tremendous amount about one's ability and likelihood for success.
quotes.author: Mark Spitz

quotes.quote: I passionately believe that's it's not just what you say that counts, it's also how you say it - that the success of your argument critically depends on your manner of presenting it.
quotes.author: Alain de Botton

quotes.quote: An investment said to have an 80% chance of success sounds far more attractive than one with a 20% chance of failure. The mind can't easily recognize that they are the same.
quotes.author: Daniel Kahneman

quotes.quote: Maintaining spirituality and humanism are the keys to success. It's a balance.
quotes.author: Bikram Choudhury

quotes.quote: Success is always something completely different to people. I feel like I've succeeded, if I'm doing something that makes me happy and I'm not lying to anybody.
quotes.author: Kristen Stewart

quotes.quote: Success is measured by your discipline and inner peace.
quotes.author: Mike Ditka

quotes.quote: When you're around enormously successful people you realise their success isn't an accident - it's about work.
quotes.author: Ryan Tedder

quotes.quote: It takes 20 years to make an overnight success.
quotes.author: Eddie Cantor

quotes.quote: The line between failure and success is so fine that we scarcely know when we pass it: so fine that we are often on the line and do not know it.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: If you carefully consider what you want to be said of you in the funeral experience, you will find your definition of success.
quotes.author: Stephen Covey

quotes.quote: I remember one day sitting at the pool and suddenly the tears were streaming down my cheeks. Why was I so unhappy? I had success. I had security. But it wasn't enough. I was exploding inside.
quotes.author: Ingrid Bergman

quotes.quote: You may lose your wife, you may lose your dog, your mother may hate you. None of those things matter. What matters is that you achieve success and become free. Then you can do whatever you like.
quotes.author: Kevin O'Leary

quotes.quote: Taxation is the price we pay for failing to build a civilized society. The higher the tax level, the greater the failure. A centrally planned totalitarian state represents a complete defeat for the civilized world, while a totally voluntary society represents its ultimate success.
quotes.author: Mark Skousen

quotes.quote: I've been surrounded by a lot of people who felt that external success would result in them feeling good about themselves. But it just seems extremely unfulfilling to me.
quotes.author: Alanis Morissette

quotes.quote: When I look in the mirror, I see someone who's happy with how he looks, because I was never one of the handsome Hollywood people. And I've had success as I've gotten older, because I'm able to play characters. I no longer get the girl, but I get the part.
quotes.author: Michael Caine

quotes.quote: I had come to the point when I realized it was unlikely that my film career was going to move beyond a certain level of role. And I was - because I had graphic instances of it - handicapped by the success of Star Trek. A director would say, 'I don't want Jean-Luc Picard in my movie' - and this was compounded by X-Men as well.
quotes.author: Patrick Stewart

quotes.quote: We all learn lessons in life. Some stick, some don't. I have always learned more from rejection and failure than from acceptance and success.
quotes.author: Henry Rollins

quotes.quote: Creativity is the key to success in the future, and primary education is where teachers can bring creativity in children at that level.
quotes.author: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

quotes.quote: Socialism has no moral justification whatsoever; poor people are not morally superior to rich people, nor are they owed anything by rich people simply because of their lack of success. Charity is not a socialist concept - it is a religious one, an acknowledgment of God's sovereignty over property, a sovereignty the Left utterly rejects.
quotes.author: Ben Shapiro

quotes.quote: Every soldier must know, before he goes into battle, how the little battle he is to fight fits into the larger picture, and how the success of his fighting will influence the battle as a whole.
quotes.author: Bernard Law Montgomery

quotes.quote: Focused, hard work is the real key to success. Keep your eyes on the goal, and just keep taking the next step towards completing it. If you aren't sure which way to do something, do it both ways and see which works better.
quotes.author: John Carmack

quotes.quote: Failures, repeated failures, are finger posts on the road to achievement. One fails forward toward success.
quotes.author: C. S. Lewis

quotes.quote: Success is a journey, not a destination. The doing is often more important than the outcome.
quotes.author: Arthur Ashe

quotes.quote: Everything you need for better future and success has already been written. And guess what? All you have to do is go to the library.
quotes.author: Henri Frederic Amiel

quotes.quote: Success and failure are both part of life. Both are not permanent.
quotes.author: Shah Rukh Khan

quotes.quote: I know of no single formula for success. But over the years I have observed that some attributes of leadership are universal and are often about finding ways of encouraging people to combine their efforts, their talents, their insights, their enthusiasm and their inspiration to work together.
quotes.author: Queen Elizabeth II

quotes.quote: No student ever attains very eminent success by simply doing what is required of him: it is the amount and excellence of what is over and above the required, that determines the greatness of ultimate distinction.
quotes.author: Charles Kendall Adams

quotes.quote: Success is often achieved by those who don't know that failure is inevitable.
quotes.author: Coco Chanel

quotes.quote: True leaders don't invest in buildings. Jesus never built a building. They invest in people. Why? Because success without a successor is failure. So your legacy should not be in buildings, programs, or projects; your legacy must be in people.
quotes.author: Myles Munroe

quotes.quote: Success in management requires learning as fast as the world is changing.
quotes.author: Warren Bennis

quotes.quote: The first step toward success is taken when you refuse to be a captive of the environment in which you first find yourself.
quotes.author: Mark Caine

quotes.quote: Finding good partners is the key to success in anything: in business, in marriage and, especially, in investing.
quotes.author: Robert Kiyosaki

quotes.quote: Make treating yourself a priority and always remember your life is happening now. Don't put off all your dreams and pleasures to another day. In any balanced personal definition of success there has to be a powerful element of living life in the present.
quotes.author: Mireille Guiliano

quotes.quote: Success on any major scale requires you to accept responsibility... in the final analysis, the one quality that all successful people have... is the ability to take on responsibility.
quotes.author: Michael Korda

quotes.quote: The only thing I have learnt over the years is that if you enjoy your work and put in the best efforts, it will show. If you follow this process, things work out. But if you go chasing a formula, success will elude you.
quotes.author: Mahesh Babu

quotes.quote: Most great people have attained their greatest success just one step beyond their greatest failure.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill

quotes.quote: Nothing succeeds like the appearance of success.
quotes.author: Christopher Lasch

quotes.quote: Enjoying success requires the ability to adapt. Only by being open to change will you have a true opportunity to get the most from your talent.
quotes.author: Nolan Ryan

quotes.quote: As my father used to tell me, the only true sign of success in life is being able to do for a living that which makes you happy.
quotes.author: Al Yankovic

quotes.quote: I think it's way harder when you have success, 'cause people tend to not treat you the same or look at you the same because they see the success or the money you make.
quotes.author: Meek Mill

quotes.quote: Success seems to be connected with action. Successful people keep moving. They make mistakes, but they don't quit.
quotes.author: Conrad Hilton

quotes.quote: Fear can be good when you're walking past an alley at night or when you need to check the locks on your doors before you go to bed, but it's not good when you have a goal and you're fearful of obstacles. We often get trapped by our fears, but anyone who has had success has failed before.
quotes.author: Queen Latifah

quotes.quote: I have an idea of who I want to be, I have a vision of my own success.
quotes.author: Wiz Khalifa

quotes.quote: Some of the best lessons we ever learn are learned from past mistakes. The error of the past is the wisdom and success of the future.
quotes.author: Dale Turner

quotes.quote: I'd rather be a failure at something I love than a success at something I hate.
quotes.author: George Burns

quotes.quote: The secret of success is constancy to purpose.
quotes.author: Benjamin Disraeli

quotes.quote: Success means having the courage, the determination, and the will to become the person you believe you were meant to be.
quotes.author: George A. Sheehan

quotes.quote: Our daily decisions and habits have a huge impact upon both our levels of happiness and success.
quotes.author: Shawn Achor

quotes.quote: Anyone who wants to sell you overnight success or wealth is not interested in your success; they are interested in your money.
quotes.author: Bo Bennett

quotes.quote: I'm not really easy to live with! There needs to be unlimited patience and unconditional love. Men I've known before loved my independent spirit and were proud of my success, to the point that they'd become jealous of the time I devote to my career.
quotes.author: Milla Jovovich

quotes.quote: Talent alone won't make you a success. Neither will being in the right place at the right time, unless you are ready. The most important question is: 'Are your ready?'
quotes.author: Johnny Carson

quotes.quote: A friend of mine said something powerful at his grandfather's funeral. He said that the greatest lesson from his grandfather's life was that he died empty, because he accomplished everything he wanted, with no regrets. I think that, along with leaving a legacy, would be the greatest sign of success.
quotes.author: Marvin Sapp

quotes.quote: Success to me is being a good person, treating people well.
quotes.author: David LaChapelle

quotes.quote: My biggest success is getting over the things that have tried to destroy and take me out of this life. Those are my biggest successes. It has nothing to do with work.
quotes.author: Tyler Perry

quotes.quote: Success is a journey, not a destination.
quotes.author: Ben Sweetland

quotes.quote: Fathers and mothers have lost the idea that the highest aspiration they might have for their children is for them to be wise... specialized competence and success are all that they can imagine.
quotes.author: Allan Bloom

quotes.quote: The most glorious moments in your life are not the so-called days of success, but rather those days when out of dejection and despair you feel rise in you a challenge to life, and the promise of future accomplishments.
quotes.author: Gustave Flaubert

quotes.quote: Success is just being happy. And I try so many different things. I do a lot of different things. Because I think God has helped me to love myself. I know who God is, and I love God.
quotes.author: Herschel Walker

quotes.quote: The optimist underestimates how difficult it is to achieve real change, believing that anything is possible and it's possible now. Only by confronting head-on the reality that all progress is going to be obstructed by vested interests and corrupted by human venality can we create realistic programmes that actually have a chance of success.
quotes.author: Julian Baggini

quotes.quote: When a small child, I thought that success spelled happiness. I was wrong, happiness is like a butterfly which appears and delights us for one brief moment, but soon flits away.
quotes.author: Anna Pavlova

quotes.quote: Over the years, I've become barraged by comments from people, such as, 'Beam me up, Scotty!' and I became defensive. I felt they were derisive and engendered an attitude. I am grateful for the success, but didn't want to be mocked.
quotes.author: William Shatner

quotes.quote: The ever quickening advances of science made possible by the success of the Human Genome Project will also soon let us see the essences of mental disease. Only after we understand them at the genetic level can we rationally seek out appropriate therapies for such illnesses as schizophrenia and bipolar disease.
quotes.author: James D. Watson

quotes.quote: Success isn't about the end result, it's about what you learn along the way.
quotes.author: Vera Wang

quotes.quote: We can all agree that government can't solve the obesity crisis alone. It's an ongoing issue that will require a collaborative effort across private and public sectors if we want to see some long-term success.
quotes.author: Marcus Samuelsson

quotes.quote: Look, if you ask a child, 'Would you rather have a fulfilled mother or a stay-at-home Sylvia Plath,' they'll pick Sylvia Plath every time. But I think it's really important that children don't feel their parents' emotional lives depend on their success.
quotes.author: Ayelet Waldman

quotes.quote: The worst part of success is, to me, adapting to it. It's scary.
quotes.author: Kendrick Lamar

quotes.quote: One of the key elements of human behavior is, humans have a greater fear of loss than enjoyment of success. All the academic studies will show you that the fear of loss of capital is far greater than the enjoyment of gains.
quotes.author: Laurence D. Fink

quotes.quote: Let every man feel that he is the architect and builder of his own life, and that he proposes to make a success of it by working.
quotes.author: Heber J. Grant

quotes.quote: Before anything else, preparation is the key to success.
quotes.author: Alexander Graham Bell

quotes.quote: Success is almost totally dependent upon drive and persistence. The extra energy required to make another effort or try another approach is the secret of winning.
quotes.author: Denis Waitley

quotes.quote: Honesty and loyalty are key. If two people can be honest with each other about everything, that's probably the biggest key to success.
quotes.author: Taylor Lautner

quotes.quote: Success is where preparation and opportunity meet.
quotes.author: Bobby Unser

quotes.quote: If you want to succeed you should strike out on new paths, rather than travel the worn paths of accepted success.
quotes.author: John D. Rockefeller

quotes.quote: I attribute my success to this - I never gave or took any excuse.
quotes.author: Florence Nightingale

quotes.quote: Success doesn't necessarily come from breakthrough innovation but from flawless execution. A great strategy alone won't win a game or a battle; the win comes from basic blocking and tackling.
quotes.author: Naveen Jain

quotes.quote: True success is overcoming the fear of being unsuccessful.
quotes.author: Paul Sweeney

quotes.quote: You've got to eat while you dream. You've got to deliver on short-range commitments, while you develop a long-range strategy and vision and implement it. The success of doing both. Walking and chewing gum if you will. Getting it done in the short-range, and delivering a long-range plan, and executing on that.
quotes.author: Jack Welch

quotes.quote: If you create incredible value and information for others that can change their lives - and you always stay focused on that service - the financial success will follow.
quotes.author: Brendon Burchard

quotes.quote: The secret of our success is that we never, never give up.
quotes.author: Wilma Mankiller

quotes.quote: Success or failure in business is caused more by the mental attitude even than by mental capacities.
quotes.author: Walter Scott

quotes.quote: While formal schooling is an important advantage, it is not a guarantee of success nor is its absence a fatal handicap.
quotes.author: Ray Kroc

quotes.quote: To this day, just always treat people the way you want to be treated. Whether it's family or friends or co-workers, I think it's the most important thing. Whether you have success or don't have it, whether you're a good person is all that matters.
quotes.author: Brenda Song

quotes.quote: Success is nothing if you don't have the right people to share it with; you're just gonna end up lonely.
quotes.author: Selena Gomez

quotes.quote: You wanna know what scares people? Success. When you don't make moves and when you don't climb up the ladder, everybody loves you because you're not competition.
quotes.author: Nicki Minaj

quotes.quote: Like success, failure is many things to many people. With Positive Mental Attitude, failure is a learning experience, a rung on the ladder, a plateau at which to get your thoughts in order and prepare to try again.
quotes.author: W. Clement Stone

quotes.quote: There is never just one thing that leads to success for anyone. I feel it always a combination of passion, dedication, hard work, and being in the right place at the right time.
quotes.author: Lauren Conrad

quotes.quote: The will to persevere is often the difference between failure and success.
quotes.author: David Sarnoff

quotes.quote: Never mind what others do; do better than yourself, beat your own record from day to day, and you are a success.
quotes.author: William J. H. Boetcker

quotes.quote: Being happy is of the utmost importance. Success in anything is through happiness.
quotes.author: Maharishi Mahesh Yogi

quotes.quote: I have seven children by six different mothers. Maybe success was too good to me.
quotes.author: Eazy-E

quotes.quote: The longer you hang in there, the greater the chance that something will happen in your favor. No matter how hard it seems, the longer you persist, the more likely your success.
quotes.author: Jack Canfield

quotes.quote: The person who makes a success of living is the one who sees his goal steadily and aims for it unswervingly.
quotes.author: Cecil B. DeMille

quotes.quote: Success soon palls. The joyous time is when the breeze first strikes your sails, and the waters rustle under your bows.
quotes.author: Charles Buxton

quotes.quote: The superior man makes the difficulty to be overcome his first interest; success only comes later.
quotes.author: Confucius

quotes.quote: Success is achieved by developing our strengths, not by eliminating our weaknesses.
quotes.author: Marilyn vos Savant

quotes.quote: We are taught to consume. And that's what we do. But if we realized that there really is no reason to consume, that it's just a mind set, that it's just an addiction, then we wouldn't be out there stepping on people's hands climbing the corporate ladder of success.
quotes.author: River Phoenix

quotes.quote: Success depends in a very large measure upon individual initiative and exertion, and cannot be achieved except by a dint of hard work.
quotes.author: Anna Pavlova

quotes.quote: You weren't born just to live a life and to die; you were born to accomplish something specifically. Matter of fact, success is making it to the end of your purpose; that is success... Success is not just existing. Success is making it to the end of why you were born.
quotes.author: Myles Munroe

quotes.quote: There is an immutable conflict at work in life and in business, a constant battle between peace and chaos. Neither can be mastered, but both can be influenced. How you go about that is the key to success.
quotes.author: Phil Knight

quotes.quote: As you become more successful, the gender barrier disappears. The credibility challenges you have during your growing up years starts disappearing when you start demonstrating success.
quotes.author: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw

quotes.quote: I believe there should be no arbitrary date set for withdrawal and yet no permanent, unending deployment. No cut and run, yet measured progress in helping a people who want to be free without an illusion of overnight success.
quotes.author: Rick Renzi

quotes.quote: Real success is not, like, materialistic. It's being where you want to be when you want to be; just living your life how you feel; having an ultimate goal and being able to accomplish it.
quotes.author: Lindsey Wixson

quotes.quote: Well, I believe that the depth of your struggle can determine the height of your success. I was inspired to come out of everything I've been through and end up in a place where I never thought that I would be.
quotes.author: R. Kelly

quotes.quote: King Louis Philippe once said to me that he attributed the great success of the British nation in political life to their talking politics after dinner.
quotes.author: Benjamin Disraeli

quotes.quote: By seizing the opportunities that disruption presents and leveraging hard times into greater success through outworking/outinnovating/outthinking and outworking everyone around you, this just might be the richest time of your life so far.
quotes.author: Robin S. Sharma

quotes.quote: I used to be really cute. I could send you earlier photos where I'm stunning. But I've gained about twenty pounds over the past two years, and the more weight I've put on, the more success I've had. If you drew a diagram of weight gain and me getting more work, a mathematician would draw some conclusions from that.
quotes.author: Zach Galifianakis

quotes.quote: Real success is not on the stage, but off the stage as a human being, and how you get along with your fellow man.
quotes.author: Sammy Davis, Jr.

quotes.quote: Success does not mean happiness. Check out any celebrity magazine to look for examples to disabuse you of thinking that being beautiful, successful or rich will make you happy.
quotes.author: Shawn Achor

quotes.quote: My mum was a wonderful mother. She died, aged 80, of Alzheimer's disease, which was dreadful to watch. I remember she said to me: 'Believe in yourself because no one else is going to do it for you.' I'm sure a lot of my success is due to her words of advice.
quotes.author: Bonnie Tyler

quotes.quote: The fame of heroes owes little to the extent of their conquests and all to the success of the tributes paid to them.
quotes.author: Jean Genet

quotes.quote: If your goal is to make money, becoming an entrepreneur is a sucker's bet. Sure, some entrepreneurs make a lot of money, but if you calculate the amount of stress-inducing work and time it takes and multiply that by the low likelihood of success and eventual payoff, it is not a great way to get rich.
quotes.author: Eric Ries

quotes.quote: On 'Sufferer,' I'm talking about the younger generation that has no other option for success than to find a gun somewhere. I try to appeal to them: 'I know you a sufferer, but it doesn't mean that you can't or shouldn't expect any better.' It's a lot different than from what I usually say, like, 'Get busy, shake that thing.'
quotes.author: Sean Paul

quotes.quote: I don't see success as the goal. Obedience is the goal.
quotes.author: Jerry B. Jenkins

quotes.quote: Learning to celebrate success is a key component of learning how to win in the market.
quotes.author: Douglas Conant

quotes.quote: I go out there to win. People don't care if you die in this business. The only way I get back is with success.
quotes.author: Michael Bay

quotes.quote: If at first you don't succeed, try, try again. Then quit. No use being a damn fool about it.
quotes.author: W.C. Fields

quotes.quote: I have no time for specialized concerns, working themes or variations that lead to mastery... I like the indefinite, the boundless; I like continual uncertainty. Other qualities may be more conducive to achievement, publicity, success; but they are all outworn - as outworn as ideologies, opinions, concepts and names for things.
quotes.author: Gerhard Richter

quotes.quote: It will, of course, be understood that directly or indirectly, soon or late, every advance in the sciences of human nature will contribute to our success in controlling human nature and changing it to the advantage of the common weal.
quotes.author: Edward Thorndike

quotes.quote: Betting on the success of innovative technologies in the marketplace can carry all the uncertainty and risk that betting on the next card in the deck does at a blackjack table in Las Vegas. There is a factor of randomness that must be factored in, but precisely how to do so is anyone's guess.
quotes.author: Henry Petroski

quotes.quote: After all, you're not exactly a nation like all the other nations. You are unique, if only because you are such an ancient people, and because of the way you are spread all over the world and your obvious success in many fields.
quotes.author: Jean-Marie Le Pen

quotes.quote: It's not about market share. If you have a successful company, you will get your market share. But to get a successful company, what do you have to have? The same metrics of success that your customer does.
quotes.author: Gordon Bethune

quotes.quote: Didn't Lionel Richie just make a country album? No one is giving him a hard time... and God bless him - I love Lionel and should be able to do what he wants to do, like Madonna should, too. Both are having success and I applaud them. If you don't like it, don't buy it. The ageism criticism is getting old.
quotes.author: Guy Oseary

quotes.quote: Everyone else trains just as hard as well and that there really is no such a thing as overnight success.
quotes.author: Julie Benz

quotes.quote: The road to success and the road to failure are almost exactly the same.
quotes.author: Colin R. Davis

quotes.quote: There's a spectrum of those moments of connection and the moments we fail to connect, going from super-large successes to failures. Success would be love, I guess, and failure could still be love, but the bad side; and loss.
quotes.author: Aimee Bender

quotes.quote: I grew up in Doncaster and have felt the love for football run through the town; it's for that reason that I have a real personal passion to make Doncaster Rovers a success story.
quotes.author: Louis Tomlinson

quotes.quote: Happy Days was about a family... although the show was shot in the 70s, it was about a family in the 50s. I realized that kids were watching their parents grow up and the parents were watching themselves grow up. That was the key to the success of our show.
quotes.author: Tom Bosley

quotes.quote: If you don't work hard, then you aren't going to have the success that you want. But if you work hard and dig in, then you are going to have the success that you want.
quotes.author: Willow Smith

quotes.quote: What we did ten years ago with the Playstation was a phenomenal success story for the company. That product had a ten year life cycle, which has never been done in this industry.
quotes.author: Ian Jackson

quotes.quote: Sometimes success will get in the way of maturity - at least temporarily.
quotes.author: Ricky Williams

quotes.quote: I would love to make my music and be completely anonymous, but that doesn't work. You can't have success and be faceless.
quotes.author: Sarah McLachlan

quotes.quote: Success comes to you with luck and a lot of hard work, but it doesn't give you the right to be any better than anybody else.
quotes.author: Nick Nolte

quotes.quote: With success came an ever-growing burden of responsibility. I lived with a near-constant low-level anxiety that I would make a mistake that would not only threaten my career, but also my brothers' - not to mention the livelihoods of many people who work with us or for us.
quotes.author: Donny Osmond

quotes.quote: Learning to appreciate those things that aren't related to success has proved the biggest lesson.
quotes.author: Chet Faker

quotes.quote: America's popular heroes have seldom been its great thinkers, and even less its scientists. The success of TV's 'Big Bang Theory,' which seems to give the lie to this claim, is more the exception that proves the rule.
quotes.author: Seth Shostak

quotes.quote: I didn't know how to deal with success. If there was a Rock Star 101, I would have liked to take it. It might have helped me.
quotes.author: Kurt Cobain

quotes.quote: It is not the going out of port, but the coming in, that determines the success of a voyage.
quotes.author: Henry Ward Beecher

quotes.quote: Success is full of promise till one gets it, and then it seems like a nest from which the bird has flown.
quotes.author: Henry Ward Beecher

quotes.quote: Think of yourself as on the threshold of unparalleled success. A whole, clear, glorious life lies before you. Achieve! Achieve!
quotes.author: Andrew Carnegie

quotes.quote: You've got to work hard for your success and you've got to have a steady presence. That's the secret.
quotes.author: Kid Rock

quotes.quote: The most absurd and reckless aspirations have sometimes led to extraordinary success.
quotes.author: Luc de Clapiers

quotes.quote: Your chances of success in any undertaking can always be measured by your belief in yourself.
quotes.author: Robert Collier

quotes.quote: I don't want to wake up and be bored. That's probably my greatest fear is to have nothing to do. What better job is there than to play quarterback for an NFL team, and certainly one that I've been on for a long time and had success with? I don't plan on giving it up any time soon.
quotes.author: Tom Brady

quotes.quote: Success is attaining your dream while helping others to benefit from that dream materializing.
quotes.author: Sugar Ray Leonard

quotes.quote: I don't want to be married to someone who feels inferior to my success or because I make more money than he does.
quotes.author: Grace Kelly

quotes.quote: Success comes from taking the initiative and following up... persisting... eloquently expressing the depth of your love. What simple action could you take today to produce a new momentum toward success in your life?
quotes.author: Tony Robbins

quotes.quote: If I wasn't even famous or had any success, I would still wake up and put tons of make-up on, and put on a cool outfit. That's always been who I've been my whole life, so that's never gonna change. I love fashion. I love getting dressed up. I love Halloween, too.
quotes.author: Gwen Stefani

quotes.quote: I don't think ethical people deal with intimidation as a method to achieve success. Undermining someone's self-esteem isn't a method to achieve success.
quotes.author: Dominique Moceanu

quotes.quote: There are people who can achieve huge success in life, while adding a bit of fun and a splash of colour to this increasingly grey world.
quotes.author: Peter James

quotes.quote: Personality is the most important thing to an actress's success.
quotes.author: Mae West

quotes.quote: The success I have achieved in bodybuilding, motion pictures, and business would not have been possible without the generosity of the American people and the freedom here to pursue your dreams.
quotes.author: Arnold Schwarzenegger

quotes.quote: Success is more difficult to handle than failure.
quotes.author: Ravi Zacharias

quotes.quote: The more defects a man may have, the older he is, the less lovable, the more resounding his success.
quotes.author: Marquis de Sade

quotes.quote: Honesty is the most single most important factor having a direct bearing on the final success of an individual, corporation, or product.
quotes.author: Ed McMahon

quotes.quote: People seldom see the halting and painful steps by which the most insignificant success is achieved.
quotes.author: Anne Sullivan

quotes.quote: Women attribute their success to working hard, luck, and help from other people. Men will attribute that - whatever success they have, that same success - to their own core skills.
quotes.author: Sheryl Sandberg

quotes.quote: Believe it or not, I have about the same success rate as anyone else. Sometimes you hit, sometimes you miss.
quotes.author: Seth MacFarlane

quotes.quote: Some say I'm an overnight success. Well, that was a very long night that lasted about 10 years. But while I do, of course, now feel the pressure having had books that have been very successful, I just know I have to concentrate on writing for myself. I can't worry about genres or markets or what might be commercial or not. That never works.
quotes.author: Kate Morton

quotes.quote: The foundation of success in life is good health: that is the substratum fortune; it is also the basis of happiness. A person cannot accumulate a fortune very well when he is sick.
quotes.author: P. T. Barnum

quotes.quote: I never expected any sort of success with 'Mockingbird'... I sort of hoped someone would like it enough to give me encouragement.
quotes.author: Harper Lee

quotes.quote: Four years of football are calculated to breed in the average man more of the ingredients of success in life than almost any academic course he takes.
quotes.author: Knute Rockne

quotes.quote: If I remain true to what's in my heart, that's all the success I need.
quotes.author: Steve Vai

quotes.quote: I was, if you like, a successful schoolboy in that I had a degree of talent in all the required things that make you a success at school.
quotes.author: Damian Lewis

quotes.quote: I think the success of a talk show depends on how true it is to the personality of the person hosting it. The shows I really admire, like 'Oprah' and 'Ellen,' are distinctively like their hosts, so I think my show will be successful only if we try to stay consistent to my own sense of myself.
quotes.author: Jane Pauley

quotes.quote: Success in show business depends on your ability to make and keep friends.
quotes.author: Sophie Tucker

quotes.quote: Fame always brings loneliness. Success is as ice cold and lonely as the North Pole.
quotes.author: Vicki Baum

quotes.quote: The most important thing for any athlete is to know his ability. If you know your ability and have even a little bit of a strong mindset, you can get success, because your ability takes you to success.
quotes.author: Virender Sehwag

quotes.quote: Starting a band is the easy part. Once you've formed the band, you have to tell a story, and that story requires songs. And not just good songs, but great songs. After a while, great songs won't do - they have to be the best. Success doesn't make it any easier. Each time I start a new record, it's a brand-new search.
quotes.author: The Edge

quotes.quote: Try not to become a man of success. Rather become a man of value.
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: The Great Idea in advertising is far more than the sum of the recognition scores, the ratings and all the other superficial indicators of its success; it is in the realm of myth, to which measurements cannot apply.
quotes.author: Leo Bogart

quotes.quote: People should decide what success means for them, and not be distracted by accepting others' definitions of success.
quotes.author: Tony Levin

quotes.quote: In Hollywood a marriage is a success if it outlasts milk.
quotes.author: Rita Rudner

quotes.quote: You just hope that you will get the opportunity to do what you love and pay your bills, and that is being a success as an actor.
quotes.author: Debra Messing

quotes.quote: Success needs no explanation. Failure does not have one that matters.
quotes.author: Jesse Jackson

quotes.quote: Monetary success is not success. Career success is not success. Life, someone that loves you, giving to others, doing something that makes you feel complete and full. That is success. And it isn't dependent on anyone else.
quotes.author: James Avery

quotes.quote: Success is very ephemeral. You depend entirely on the desire of others, which makes it difficult to relax.
quotes.author: Eva Green

quotes.quote: At the end of the day, both men and women who become CEOs have showed tenacity and hard work to succeed in their careers. It takes not just skills but also extreme dedication and commitment. And regardless of gender, CEOs are measured by the same criteria - the growth and success of the business.
quotes.author: Susan Wojcicki

quotes.quote: What I have in common with the character in 'Truman' is this incredible need to please people. I feel like I want to take care of everyone and I also feel this terrible guilt if I am unable to. And I have felt this way ever since all this success started.
quotes.author: Jim Carrey

quotes.quote: You always pass failure on your way to success.
quotes.author: Mickey Rooney

quotes.quote: Temporary success can be achieved in spite of lack of other fundamental qualities, but no advancements can be maintained without hard work.
quotes.author: William Feather

quotes.quote: Hope is a state of mind, not of the world. Hope, in this deep and powerful sense, is not the same as joy that things are going well, or willingness to invest in enterprises that are obviously heading for success, but rather an ability to work for something because it is good.
quotes.author: Vaclav Havel

quotes.quote: Humility is becoming a lost art, but it's not difficult to practice. It means that you realize that others have been involved in your success.
quotes.author: Harvey Mackay

quotes.quote: Whether a party can have much success without a woman present I must ask others to decide, but one thing is certain, no party is any fun unless seasoned with folly.
quotes.author: Desiderius Erasmus

quotes.quote: Picture yourself vividly as winning, and that alone will contribute immeasurably to success.
quotes.author: Harry Emerson Fosdick

quotes.quote: One is never ready for success. It consecrates and looses you at the same time.
quotes.author: Isabelle Adjani

quotes.quote: These rules may seem simple enough, but it will require great morale and physical courage to adhere to them. But if carried out in the strict sense of the word it will surely lead to a greater success than could otherwise be attained.
quotes.author: Major Taylor

quotes.quote: For some reason, we can't just enjoy somebody else's success. Somehow, that's going to affect us. If they have more, then I have less - and I don't know why.
quotes.author: Ellen DeGeneres

quotes.quote: Encouragement of higher education for our youth is critical to the success of our collective future.
quotes.author: Charles B. Rangel

quotes.quote: But I like not these great success of yours; for I know how jealous are the gods.
quotes.author: Herodotus

quotes.quote: My success isn't a result of arrogance - it's a result of belief.
quotes.author: Conor McGregor

quotes.quote: A woman who is loved always has success.
quotes.author: Vicki Baum

quotes.quote: Commitment, belief and positive attitude are all important if you're going to be a success, whether you're in sports, in business or, as in my case, anthropology.
quotes.author: Donald Johanson

quotes.quote: An empowered organisation is one in which individuals have the knowledge, skill, desire, and opportunity to personally succeed in a way that leads to collective organisational success.
quotes.author: Stephen Covey

quotes.quote: My success has been something I've worked a long time at and it's been a gradual process. I compare it to the idea of someone losing a lot of weight over a period of a few years. You don't really notice the weight loss overall but if you compare photos from then and now there's a big difference.
quotes.author: Ray William Johnson

quotes.quote: The ladder of success is never crowded at the top.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill
