quotes.quote: An excuse becomes an obstacle in your journey to success when it is made in place of your best effort or when it is used as the object of the blame.
quotes.author: Bo Bennett

quotes.quote: Before success comes in any man's life, he's sure to meet with much temporary defeat and, perhaps some failures. When defeat overtakes a man, the easiest and the most logical thing to do is to quit. That's exactly what the majority of men do.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill

quotes.quote: Time is the most precious element of human existence. The successful person knows how to put energy into time and how to draw success from time.
quotes.author: Denis Waitley

quotes.quote: I believe in luck: how else can you explain the success of those you dislike?
quotes.author: Jean Cocteau

quotes.quote: All of us are born for a reason, but all of us don't discover why. Success in life has nothing to do with what you gain in life or accomplish for yourself. It's what you do for others.
quotes.author: Danny Thomas

quotes.quote: After a lifetime of working, raising families, and contributing to the success of this nation in countless other ways, senior citizens deserve to retire with dignity.
quotes.author: Charlie Gonzalez

quotes.quote: There's no success story. Everybody's got a ghetto story. You always want to make it bigger than what it is.
quotes.author: Bernie Mac

quotes.quote: My store, Wine Library, outsells big national chains. How do you think we do it? It started with hustle. I always say that our success wasn't due to my hundreds of online videos about wine that went viral, but to the hours I spent talking to people online afterward, making connections and building relationships.
quotes.author: Gary Vaynerchuk

quotes.quote: To have success in your professional life is not so hard. To succeed as a man is more difficult.
quotes.author: Yann Arthus-Bertrand

quotes.quote: Success usually comes to those who are too busy to be looking for it.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: You are a product of your environment. So choose the environment that will best develop you toward your objective. Analyze your life in terms of its environment. Are the things around you helping you toward success - or are they holding you back?
quotes.author: W. Clement Stone

quotes.quote: Success is neither magical nor mysterious. Success is the natural consequence of consistently applying the basic fundamentals.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.quote: Let us realize that: the privilege to work is a gift, the power to work is a blessing, the love of work is success!
quotes.author: David O. McKay

quotes.quote: Anybody who succeeds is helping people. The secret to success is find a need and fill it; find a hurt and heal it; find a problem and solve it.
quotes.author: Robert H. Schuller

quotes.quote: The compensation of a very early success is a conviction that life is a romantic matter. In the best sense one stays young.
quotes.author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

quotes.quote: Almost no one is foolish enough to imagine that he automatically deserves great success in any field of activity; yet almost everyone believes that he automatically deserves success in marriage.
quotes.author: Sydney J. Harris

quotes.quote: It is wise to keep in mind that neither success nor failure is ever final.
quotes.author: Roger Babson

quotes.quote: I've known entrepreneurs who were not great salespeople, or didn't know how to code, or were not particularly charismatic leaders. But I don't know of any entrepreneurs who have achieved any level of success without persistence and determination.
quotes.author: Harvey Mackay

quotes.quote: Everybody loves success, but they hate successful people.
quotes.author: John McEnroe

quotes.quote: The decadent international but individualistic capitalism in the hands of which we found ourselves after the war is not a success. It is not intelligent. It is not beautiful. It is not just. It is not virtuous. And it doesn't deliver the goods.
quotes.author: John Maynard Keynes

quotes.quote: Microsoft has had two goals in the last 10 years. One was to copy the Mac, and the other was to copy Lotus' success in the spreadsheet - basically, the applications business. And over the course of the last 10 years, Microsoft accomplished both of those goals. And now they are completely lost.
quotes.author: Steve Jobs

quotes.quote: Try to look at your weakness and convert it into your strength. That's success.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.quote: What material success does is provide you with the ability to concentrate on other things that really matter. And that is being able to make a difference, not only in your own life, but in other people's lives.
quotes.author: Oprah Winfrey

quotes.quote: A constant struggle, a ceaseless battle to bring success from inhospitable surroundings, is the price of all great achievements.
quotes.author: Orison Swett Marden

quotes.quote: Within the hearts men, loyalty and consideration are esteemed greater than success.
quotes.author: Bryant H. McGill

quotes.quote: The definition of success to me is not necessarily a price tag, not fame, but having a good life, and being able to say I did the right thing at the end of the day.
quotes.author: Jeremy Luke

quotes.quote: It is better to fail in originality than to succeed in imitation.
quotes.author: Herman Melville

quotes.quote: Thought is the original source of all wealth, all success, all material gain, all great discoveries and inventions, and of all achievement.
quotes.author: Claude M. Bristol

quotes.quote: We must walk consciously only part way toward our goal, and then leap in the dark to our success.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: Education is the key to success in life, and teachers make a lasting impact in the lives of their students.
quotes.author: Solomon Ortiz

quotes.quote: Whether you come from a council estate or a country estate, your success will be determined by your own confidence and fortitude.
quotes.author: Michelle Obama

quotes.quote: Success and money can really be quite blinding.
quotes.author: Jim Harrison

quotes.quote: All those who are around me are the bridge to my success, so they are all important.
quotes.author: Manny Pacquiao

quotes.quote: Kids are meant to believe that their stepping stone to massive money is 'The X Factor.' Luck is great, but most of life is hard work. We do not celebrate people who have made success out of serious hard work.
quotes.author: Iain Duncan Smith

quotes.quote: People think your success is just a matter of having a pretty face. But it's easy to be chewed up and spat out. You've got to stay ahead of the game to be able to stay in it.
quotes.author: Kate Moss

quotes.quote: Every person who wins in any undertaking must be willing to cut all sources of retreat. Only by doing so can one be sure of maintaining that state of mind known as a burning desire to win - essential to success.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill

quotes.quote: True leadership lies in guiding others to success. In ensuring that everyone is performing at their best, doing the work they are pledged to do and doing it well.
quotes.author: Bill Owens

quotes.quote: Success for an athlete follows many years of hard work and dedication.
quotes.author: Michael Diamond

quotes.quote: Raising children is an uncertain thing; success is reached only after a life of battle and worry.
quotes.author: Democritus

quotes.quote: Through perseverance many people win success out of what seemed destined to be certain failure.
quotes.author: Benjamin Disraeli

quotes.quote: Singleness of purpose is one of the chief essentials for success in life, no matter what may be one's aim.
quotes.author: John D. Rockefeller

quotes.quote: I see my upbringing as a great success story. By disciplining me, my parents inculcated self-discipline. And by restricting my choices as a child, they gave me so many choices in my life as an adult. Because of what they did then, I get to do the work I love now.
quotes.author: Amy Chua

quotes.quote: I am decidedly of the opinion that in very many instances we can trace such a necessary connexion, especially among birds, and often with more complete success than in the case which I have here attempted to explain.
quotes.author: Alfred Russel Wallace

quotes.quote: Success has nothing to do with what you gain in life or accomplish for yourself. It's what you do for others.
quotes.author: Danny Thomas

quotes.quote: Success is about enjoying what you have and where you are, while pursuing achievable goals.
quotes.author: Bo Bennett

quotes.quote: Every failure is a step to success.
quotes.author: William Whewell

quotes.quote: Sustainability is the key to our survival on this planet and will also determine success on all levels.
quotes.author: Shari Arison

quotes.quote: Not every difficult and dangerous thing is suitable for training, but only that which is conducive to success in achieving the object of our effort.
quotes.author: Epictetus

quotes.quote: There is no force like success, and that is why the individual makes all effort to surround himself throughout life with the evidence of it; as of the individual, so should it be of the nation.
quotes.author: Marcus Garvey

quotes.quote: Success can make you go one of two ways. It can make you a prima donna - or it can smooth the edges, take away the insecurities, let the nice things come out.
quotes.author: Barbara Walters

quotes.quote: Mistakes are the best teachers. One does not learn from success. It is desirable to learn vicariously from other people's failures, but it gets much more firmly seared in when they are your own.
quotes.author: Mohnish Pabrai

quotes.quote: To burn always with this hard, gem-like flame, to maintain this ecstasy, is success in life.
quotes.author: Walter Pater

quotes.quote: Because after my first year I had a lot of success, took everybody by storm, came back the next year thought it was easy and didn't have near the season I had the previous year. It was kind of a wake-up call. And so, life goes on.
quotes.author: Brett Favre

quotes.quote: God gave me a second chance. I am so very glad with what is going on with my career, but I want to be a success in my relationship with my children.
quotes.author: El DeBarge

quotes.quote: It's how you deal with failure that determines how you achieve success.
quotes.author: Charlotte Whitton

quotes.quote: I used to define success as being able to produce any result you wanted, whether it was a relationship, weight-loss, being a millionaire, impacting the culture, changing society, whatever it might be - it might be homelessness, whatever - and lately, I've redefined success as 'fulfilling your soul's purpose.'
quotes.author: Jack Canfield

quotes.quote: Success is what you do with your ability. It's how you use your talent.
quotes.author: George Allen, Sr.

quotes.quote: PETA has a proven track record of success. Each victory PETA wins for the animals is a stepping stone upon which we build a more compassionate world for all beings - and we will never give up our fight until all animals are treated with respect and kindness.
quotes.author: Bea Arthur

quotes.quote: My biggest failure is 'Metal Gear.' It's my biggest failure and my biggest success.
quotes.author: Hideo Kojima

quotes.quote: Also, it's risky to try to duplicate earlier success. Magician had a certain charm to it, mostly due to my choice of lead characters, that I would be hard put to duplicate.
quotes.author: Raymond E. Feist

quotes.quote: I want anyone who believes in life, liberty, pursuit of happiness to succeed. And I want any force, any person, any element of an overarching Big Government that would stop your success, I want that organization, that element or that person to fail. I want you to succeed.
quotes.author: Rush Limbaugh

quotes.quote: The only yardstick for success our society has is being a champion. No one remembers anything else.
quotes.author: John Madden

quotes.quote: I'm an eternal realist and the success rate for being an actor is pretty low.
quotes.author: Tom Hiddleston

quotes.quote: Find a good teacher that will keep the game fun. Work hard and don't be afraid to have success or disappointment. That is what golf is all about.
quotes.author: Paula Creamer

quotes.quote: Success consists in being successful, not in having potential for success. Any wide piece of ground is the potential site of a palace, but there's no palace till it's built.
quotes.author: Fernando Pessoa

quotes.quote: If I write a book where all I've ever experienced is success, people won't take a positive lesson from it. In being candid, I have to own up to my own failures, both in my marriage and in my work environment.
quotes.author: Sonia Sotomayor

quotes.quote: What's really cool about our family is that we don't hold grudges, and I think that is what's been the key to the success. We get into our little disagreements, and whether we're right or wrong, we'll go and apologize. That's just the way we are.
quotes.author: Selena

quotes.quote: I planned my success. I knew it was going to happen.
quotes.author: Erykah Badu

quotes.quote: Great leaders understand that historical success tends to produce stable and inwardly focused organizations, and these outfits, in turn, reinforce a feeling of contentment with the status quo.
quotes.author: John P. Kotter

quotes.quote: I always think part of success is being able to replicate results, taking what is interesting or viable about yourself as a professional person and seeing if you bring it into different situations with similar results.
quotes.author: Robert Downey, Jr.

quotes.quote: Success is doing ordinary things extraordinarily well.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.quote: We're constantly striving for success, fame and comfort when all we really need to be happy is someone or some thing to be enthusiastic about.
quotes.author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.

quotes.quote: I never feel any pressure about a film. What is meant to happen will happen. I have seen failure as well as success several times.
quotes.author: Akshay Kumar

quotes.quote: There's not an instruction manual on how to deal with success, so you just have to rely on having great friends and a good team.
quotes.author: Bryan Adams

quotes.quote: The great dream merchant Disney was a success because make-believe was what everyone seemed to need in a spiritually empty land.
quotes.author: Arthur Erickson

quotes.quote: So be sure when you step, Step with care and great tact. And remember that life's A Great Balancing Act. And will you succeed? Yes! You will, indeed! (98 and Â¾ percent guaranteed) Kid, you'll move mountains.
quotes.author: Dr. Seuss,  Oh, The Places You'll Go!

quotes.quote: There's no secret about success. Did you ever know a successful man who didn't tell you about it?
quotes.author: Kin Hubbard

quotes.quote: Teach success before teaching responsibility. Teach them to believe in themselves. Teach them to think, 'I'm not stupid'. No child wants to fail. Everyone wants to succeed.
quotes.author: Al Green

quotes.quote: A lot of people don't have near the amount of success as I've been blessed to have, and it's all about working hard and hoping that continues.
quotes.author: Luke Bryan

quotes.quote: Nothing is as seductive as the assurance of success.
quotes.author: Gertrude Himmelfarb

quotes.quote: When I sit here and see that the eight brothers from the neighborhood that I grew up with still have success, it had to be magical. I doubt if you get another 'Wu-Tang Clan.' That might be harder than getting the new 'Jackson Five.' Certain groups you only get one time, and we just happened to be that group.
quotes.author: Raekwon

quotes.quote: If a man has been his mother's undisputed darling he retains throughout life the triumphant feeling, the confidence in success, which not seldom brings actual success along with it.
quotes.author: Sigmund Freud

quotes.quote: The lesson is, because there will be many lemons in life, to learn to make the proverbial lemonade - and be open and honest. That's the best way of doing damage control and positioning yourself for success.
quotes.author: Vivek Wadhwa

quotes.quote: I don't really measure success by anything other than if I am happy. That is success to me. Am I happy waking up every morning? And despite the challenges of running my own business, do I look forward to going to work? Absolutely.
quotes.author: L'Wren Scott

quotes.quote: However things may seem, no evil thing is success and no good thing is failure.
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.quote: Breast cancer deaths in America have been declining for more than a decade. Much of that success is due to early detection and better treatments for women. I strongly encourage women to get a mammogram.
quotes.author: Larry Craig

quotes.quote: Success unshared is failure.
quotes.author: John Paul DeJoria

quotes.quote: I like people who are able to keep pushing themselves and challenging themselves even after great success.
quotes.author: John C. Reilly

quotes.quote: The hardest thing to find in life is balance - especially, the more success you have, the more you look to the other side of the gate.
quotes.author: Celine Dion

quotes.quote: Yes I have made a lot of money and I have a lot of respect, my films have done well, and I know there are loads of loads of people who look up to me and really love me. I really just thought this is like a strange dream. I have never thought this is a success - I don't have a standard.
quotes.author: Shah Rukh Khan

quotes.quote: The success that Americans are said to worship is success of a specific sort: accomplished not through hard work, primarily, but through the ingenious angle, the big break. Sit down at a lunch counter, stand back up a star. Invest in a new issue and watch it soar. Split a single atom, win a war.
quotes.author: Walter Kirn

quotes.quote: A true measure of your worth includes all the benefits others have gained from your success.
quotes.author: Cullen Hightower

quotes.quote: But once you have some success in one style, the business wants to lock you in that vein forever.
quotes.author: Richard Marx

quotes.quote: I think success right now is not about how famous you are or how much you're getting paid, but it's more about if you're steadily working and you're happy with what you're doing.
quotes.author: Sarah Hyland

quotes.quote: One of my producers said this business is like a hamster on that little wheel thing that goes around and around. You may have a great day and get great ratings, but then you've got another show to do - whatever moment of success or happiness you have you've got to keep grinding it out for the next day.
quotes.author: Sean Hannity

quotes.quote: A man came up to me at a party and asked if I wanted to be in his video game. I of course said yes. And then it turned out it was 'Assassin's Creed', so that was great. They let me ad lib a lot and mess about and be very snarky indeed, and I'm thrilled by the success of all their hard work.
quotes.author: Danny Wallace

quotes.quote: If not for the success that medicine has made, I might be part of a much different story right now.
quotes.author: Kareem Abdul-Jabbar

quotes.quote: I've had my share of struggle. I believe, never take success to your head or failure to your heart.
quotes.author: Randeep Hooda

quotes.quote: I just go where my heart tells me, where my gut tells me to go, where I'm enjoying my life the most, where I feel like I can have the most success. I've truly enjoyed my experience in NASCAR, to the point that I want to do it full time.
quotes.author: Danica Patrick

quotes.quote: Success is getting what you want, happiness is wanting what you get
quotes.author: W.P. Kinsella

quotes.quote: The system that enables the most people to earn the most success is free enterprise, by matching up people's skills, interests, and abilities. In contrast, redistribution simply spreads money around. Even worse, it attenuates the ability to earn success by perverting economic incentives.
quotes.author: Arthur C. Brooks

quotes.quote: We live in a beauty-obsessed age and success sometimes appears to hinge solely on the presentation of an image that is acceptable to the press.
quotes.author: Douglas Booth

quotes.quote: Evolution does not necessarily favor the longest-lived. It doesn't necessarily favor the biggest or the strongest or the fastest, and not even the smartest. Evolution favors those creatures best adapted to their environment. That is the sole test of survival and success.
quotes.author: Harvey V. Fineberg

quotes.quote: I've had great success and I've had catastrophic failure. It's really how you handle the rough stuff that defines you, I think.
quotes.author: Peter Berg

quotes.quote: I live again the days and evenings of my long career. I dream at night of operas and concerts in which I have had my share of success. Now like the old Irish minstrel, I have hung up my harp because my songs are all sung.
quotes.author: John McCormack

quotes.quote: In actuality, California could be a wonderful place to live. In fact, if you're highly educated and ambitious, you can do quite well here while enjoying the sun and the fun. The only problem: California will then blame you for your success and recommend that all your cash be removed from you.
quotes.author: Ben Shapiro

quotes.quote: Allowing a handful of broadband carriers to determine what people see and do online would fundamentally undermine the features that have made the Internet such a success, and could permanently compromise the Internet as a platform for the free exchange of information, commerce, and ideas.
quotes.author: Vint Cerf

quotes.quote: Success is a great deodorant.
quotes.author: Elizabeth Taylor

quotes.quote: To have a childhood surrounded by people like Sir Laurence Olivier and Vivien Leigh sounds glitzy, but for years I wanted to repress it. I couldn't take that kind of power and success.
quotes.author: Michael Korda

quotes.quote: The key to success is to focus our conscious mind on things we desire not things we fear.
quotes.author: Brian Tracy

quotes.quote: Failure is the condiment that gives success its flavor.
quotes.author: Truman Capote

quotes.quote: Failure is not our only punishment for laziness; there is also the success of others.
quotes.author: Jules Renard

quotes.quote: Perseverance is a great element of success. If you only knock long enough and loud enough at the gate, you are sure to wake up somebody.
quotes.author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

quotes.quote: The success of the Rat Pack or the Clan was due to the camaraderie, the three guys who work together and kid each other and love each other.
quotes.author: Sammy Davis, Jr.

quotes.quote: Fact: From quitting smoking to skiing, we succeed to the degree we try, fail, and learn. Studies show that people who worry about mistakes shut down, but those who are relaxed about doing badly soon learn to do well. Success is built on failure.
quotes.author: Martha Beck

quotes.quote: The path to success is to take massive, determined action.
quotes.author: Tony Robbins

quotes.quote: They talk about the failure of socialism but where is the success of capitalism in Africa, Asia and Latin America?
quotes.author: Fidel Castro

quotes.quote: When you see something that is technically sweet, you go ahead and do it and you argue about what to do about it only after you have had your technical success. That is the way it was with the atomic bomb.
quotes.author: J. Robert Oppenheimer

quotes.quote: The measure of success is happiness and peace of mind.
quotes.author: Bobby Davro

quotes.quote: That some achieve great success, is proof to all that others can achieve it as well.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: I always say that the real success of Wine Library wasn't due to the videos I posted, but to the hours I spent talking to people online afterward, making connections and building relationships.
quotes.author: Gary Vaynerchuk

quotes.quote: You grow up a bit damaged or broken then you have some success but you don't know how to feel good about the work you're doing or the life you're leading.
quotes.author: Johnny Depp

quotes.quote: Being kind is the most important thing I've ever been taught. That's what my parents always told me - more important than ambition or success is being kind to people. The cornerstone of my life. What I aspire to is to be kind.
quotes.author: Rafe Spall

quotes.quote: You've got to ask! Asking is, in my opinion, the world's most powerful - and neglected - secret to success and happiness.
quotes.author: Percy Ross

quotes.quote: Every day is a new opportunity. You can build on yesterday's success or put its failures behind and start over again. That's the way life is, with a new game every day, and that's the way baseball is.
quotes.author: Bob Feller

quotes.quote: There's two kinds of rock n' roll casualty: the one that has huge success and adoration, and then suddenly it stops. Or there's when you're in a band: it is all-consuming, so then you have the dream of that, and then the dream's taken away from you even before it happens.
quotes.author: Rhys Ifans

quotes.quote: I just felt it was my job to show that there is no easy way to success, and that anyone who gets even just one Top 40 hit deserves their moment in the sun. I accentuate the positive and eliminate the negative. That is the timeless thing.
quotes.author: Casey Kasem

quotes.quote: We crave instant success these days. If you are a really good sprinter and long jumper, you don't want to spend two or three years on a whole new set of events. You're used to doing well and it's difficult to give that up.
quotes.author: Daley Thompson

quotes.quote: People equate success with youth. And if you haven't had a certain amount of success by a certain time in your life, it's never going to happen. There's a fear about that. So people start lying about their age really young. I've never done that because I think it's so insignificant.
quotes.author: Jennifer Jason Leigh

quotes.quote: People who get involved with the success of something have to be given at least some share of that success.
quotes.author: Michael Ironside

quotes.quote: Do what your inner soul tells you to do, regardless of any money or success it will bring you.
quotes.author: Etel Adnan

quotes.quote: Fighting for one's freedom, struggling towards being free, is like struggling to be a poet or a good Christian or a good Jew or a good Muslim or good Zen Buddhist. You work all day long and achieve some kind of level of success by nightfall, go to sleep and wake up the next morning with the job still to be done. So you start all over again.
quotes.author: Maya Angelou

quotes.quote: The worst part of success is trying to find someone who is happy for you.
quotes.author: Bette Midler

quotes.quote: There are millions of Americans outside Washington who are tired of stale political arguments and are moving this country forward. They believe, and I believe, that here in America, our success should depend not on accident of birth, but the strength of our work ethic and the scope of our dreams.
quotes.author: Barack Obama

quotes.quote: The negative side of the American Dream comes when people pursue success at any cost, which in turn destroys the vision and the dream.
quotes.author: Azar Nafisi

quotes.quote: Be passionate and bold. Always keep learning. You stop doing useful things if you don't learn. So the last part to me is the key, especially if you have had some initial success. It becomes even more critical that you have the learning 'bit' always switched on.
quotes.author: Satya Nadella

quotes.quote: Change can either challenge or threaten us. Your beliefs pave your way to success or block you.
quotes.author: Marsha Sinetar

quotes.quote: Old age is like everything else. To make a success of it, you've got to start young.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt

quotes.quote: If God has made the world a perfect mechanism, He has at least conceded so much to our imperfect intellect that in order to predict little parts of it, we need not solve innumerable differential equations, but can use dice with fair success.
quotes.author: Max Born

quotes.quote: Success isn't permanent and failure isn't fatal.
quotes.author: Mike Ditka

quotes.quote: The only true measure of success is the ratio between what we might have done and what we might have been on the one hand, and the thing we have made and the things we have made of ourselves on the other.
quotes.author: H. G. Wells

quotes.quote: A man with a silver spoon may get his share of supporters, but he can never be an inspiration for somebody! Patience and hard work are the key to every man's success.
quotes.author: Kailash Kher

quotes.quote: Ask any successful person to look back over the events of his or her life, and chances are there'll be a turning point of one kind or another. It doesn't matter if that success has come on a ball field or in a boardroom, in a research laboratory or on a campaign trail - it can usually be traced to some pivotal moment.
quotes.author: Bill Rancic

quotes.quote: I'm an American. We've translated democracy and brotherhood and equality into enterprise and opportunity and success - and that's getting Americanised.
quotes.author: Susan Glaspell

quotes.quote: You never achieve success unless you like what you are doing.
quotes.author: Dale Carnegie

quotes.quote: Perseverance - a lowly virtue whereby mediocrity achieves an inglorious success.
quotes.author: Ambrose Bierce

quotes.quote: Have no fear of perfection - you'll never reach it.
quotes.author: Salvador DalÃ­

quotes.quote: I'm not hungry for success. I am only hungry for good work, and that is how it is with most superstars. Every day I tell myself how fortunate I am to be where I am.
quotes.author: Akshay Kumar

quotes.quote: To put it bluntly, there isn't one economic theory that can single-handedly explain Singapore's success; its economy combines extreme features of capitalism and socialism. All theories are partial; reality is complex.
quotes.author: Ha-Joon Chang

quotes.quote: Thus they have an idol that they petition for victory in war; another for success in their labors; and so for everything in which they seek or desire prosperity, they have their idols, which they honor and serve.
quotes.author: Hernan Cortes

quotes.quote: Success is stumbling from failure to failure with no loss of enthusiasm.
quotes.author: Winston S. Churchill

quotes.quote: I have had unsuccessful films, but I learned a lot from those films. I give my failures as much importance as my success.
quotes.author: Aamir Khan

quotes.quote: The world is apt to judge of everything by the success; and whoever has ill fortune will hardly be allowed a good name.
quotes.author: William Dampier

quotes.quote: When I meet successful people I ask 100 questions as to what they attribute their success to. It is usually the same: persistence, hard work and hiring good people.
quotes.author: Kiana Tom

quotes.quote: If A is a success in life, then A equals x plus y plus z. Work is x; y is play; and z is keeping your mouth shut
quotes.author: Albert Einstein

quotes.quote: Success is not to be pursued; it is to be attracted by the person you become.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.quote: Success is not built on success. It's built on failure. It's built on frustration. Sometimes its built on catastrophe.
quotes.author: Sumner Redstone

quotes.quote: The making of friends who are real friends, is the best token we have of a man's success in life.
quotes.author: Edward Everett Hale

quotes.quote: If you work just for money, you'll never make it, but if you love what you're doing and you always put the customer first, success will be yours.
quotes.author: Ray Kroc

quotes.quote: Letting go means to come to the realization that some people are a part of your history, but not a part of your destiny.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: Problems or successes, they all are the results of our own actions. Karma. The philosophy of action is that no one else is the giver of peace or happiness. One's own karma, one's own actions are responsible to come to bring either happiness or success or whatever.
quotes.author: Maharishi Mahesh Yogi

quotes.quote: Success comes to those who have an entire mountain of gold that they continually mine, not those who find one nugget and try to live on it for fifty years.
quotes.author: John C. Maxwell

quotes.quote: Success is about dedication. You may not be where you want to be or do what you want to do when you're on the journey. But you've got to be willing to have vision and foresight that leads you to an incredible end.
quotes.author: Usher

quotes.quote: A person has to remember that the road to success is always under construction. You have to get that through your head. That it is not easy becoming successful.
quotes.author: Steve Harvey

quotes.quote: The distance between insanity and genius is measured only by success.
quotes.author: Bruce Feirstein

quotes.quote: I feel like I want to take care of everyone and I also feel this terrible guilt if I am unable to. And I have felt this way ever since all this success started.
quotes.author: Jim Carrey

quotes.quote: Starting a business isn't for everyone, and it's not what you should do if you aren't sure what else to do. It requires thick skin and the willingness to carry a great deal of stress, sometimes alone. It's more often a life of failure than a life of success, and the majority of successes came after a long road of disappointment, and often shame.
quotes.author: Kathryn Minshew

quotes.quote: My mother was the most beautiful woman I ever saw. All I am I owe to my mother. I attribute all my success in life to the moral, intellectual and physical education I received from her.
quotes.author: George Washington

quotes.quote: Don't spend time beating on a wall, hoping to transform it into a door.
quotes.author: Coco Chanel

quotes.quote: Creative risk taking is essential to success in any goal where the stakes are high. Thoughtless risks are destructive, of course, but perhaps even more wasteful is thoughtless caution which prompts inaction and promotes failure to seize opportunity.
quotes.author: Gary Ryan Blair

quotes.quote: People talk about bullying, but you can be your own bully in some ways. You can be the person who is standing in the way of your success, and that was the case for me.
quotes.author: Katy Perry

quotes.quote: If there is any one secret of success, it lies in the ability to get the other person's point of view and see things from that person's angle as well as from your own.
quotes.author: Henry Ford

quotes.quote: Procrastination is one of the most common and deadliest of diseases and its toll on success and happiness is heavy.
quotes.author: Wayne Gretzky

quotes.quote: I must admit that I personally measure success in terms of the contributions an individual makes to her or his fellow human beings.
quotes.author: Margaret Mead

quotes.quote: The two most important requirements for major success are: first, being in the right place at the right time, and second, doing something about it.
quotes.author: Ray Kroc

quotes.quote: Everyone who achieves success in a great venture, solves each problem as they came to it. They helped themselves. And they were helped through powers known and unknown to them at the time they set out on their voyage. They keep going regardless of the obstacles they met.
quotes.author: W. Clement Stone

quotes.quote: I'm a success today because I had a friend who believed in me and I didn't have the heart to let him down.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: Success is having to worry about every damn thing in the world, except money.
quotes.author: Johnny Cash

quotes.quote: Anyone whose goal is 'something higher' must expect someday to suffer vertigo. What is vertigo? Fear of falling? No, Vertigo is something other than fear of falling. It is the voice of the emptiness below us which tempts and lures us, it is the desire to fall, against which, terrified, we defend ourselves.
quotes.author: Milan Kundera,  The Unbearable Lightness of Being

quotes.quote: Your success depends mainly upon what you think of yourself and whether you believe in yourself.
quotes.author: William J. H. Boetcker

quotes.quote: Success represents the 1% of your work which results from the 99% that is called failure.
quotes.author: Soichiro Honda

quotes.quote: Good planning is important. I've also regarded a sense of humor as one of the most important things on a big expedition. When you're in a difficult or dangerous situation, or when you're depressed about the chances of success, someone who can make you laugh eases the tension.
quotes.author: Edmund Hillary

quotes.quote: Luxury is the wolf at the door and its fangs are the vanities and conceits germinated by success. When an artist learns this, he knows where the danger is.
quotes.author: Tennessee Williams

quotes.quote: I think that my biggest attribute to any success that I have had is hard work. There really is no substitute for working hard.
quotes.author: Maria Bartiromo

quotes.quote: Private dreams are the most powerful. You have to dream of success to make it happen, and if you don't believe in yourself, nobody else will. But that doesn't mean you have to go around telling everyone about it.
quotes.author: Tony McCoy

quotes.quote: True success, true happiness lies in freedom and fulfillment.
quotes.author: Dada Vaswani

quotes.quote: Whatever obstacle comes your way, you gotta be prepared to jump over it! And I think that's what separates the legends from the regular artists. It's all in how you manage that success, and how you deal with the controversy when it actually comes.
quotes.author: Akon

quotes.quote: The most important thing is being passionate about what you're doing and always give it your all. That is the key to success.
quotes.author: Charlie White

quotes.quote: I'm not going to get somewhere and say, 'OK, I'm done.' Success is never final; I'll just keep on going. The same way as failure never being fatal. Just keep going. I'm going to the stars and then past them.
quotes.author: Conor McGregor

quotes.quote: The single most important key to success is to be a good listener.
quotes.author: Kelly Wearstler

quotes.quote: There is a deep sadness to American poverty, greater than the sadness of any other kind. It's because America has such an ideology of success.
quotes.author: Will Self

quotes.quote: In the first six to twelve months of a war with the United States and Great Britain I will run wild and win victory upon victory. But then, if the war continues after that, I have no expectation of success.
quotes.author: Isoroku Yamamoto

quotes.quote: Success is not in never failing, but rising everytime you fall!
quotes.author: Jonathan Taylor Thomas

quotes.quote: The success of the suffrage movement would injure women spiritually and intellectually, for they would be assuming a burden though they knew themselves unable to bear it. It is the sediment, not the wave, of a sex. It is the antithesis of that highest and sweetest mystery - conviction by submission, and conquest by sacrifice.
quotes.author: John Boyle O'Reilly

quotes.quote: Post-operatively the transplanted kidney functioned immediately with a dramatic improvement in the patient's renal and cardiopulmonary status. This spectacular success was a clear demonstration that organ transplantation could be life-saving.
quotes.author: Joseph Murray

quotes.quote: In order to succeed, your desire for success should be greater than your fear of failure.
quotes.author: Bill Cosby

quotes.quote: The secret to success is to offend the greatest number of people.
quotes.author: George Bernard Shaw

quotes.quote: Success is the progressive realization of a worthy goal or ideal.
quotes.author: Earl Nightingale

quotes.quote: In a lot of ways, success is much harder than I thought it would be. I figured that you'd get here and then everything would be happily ever after. But, it's hard work, almost harder once you're successful because you've got to maintain it.
quotes.author: Steven Wright

quotes.quote: Ultimately, leadership is not about glorious crowning acts. It's about keeping your team focused on a goal and motivated to do their best to achieve it, especially when the stakes are high and the consequences really matter. It is about laying the groundwork for others' success, and then standing back and letting them shine.
quotes.author: Chris Hadfield

quotes.quote: Think little goals and expect little achievements. Think big goals and win big success.
quotes.author: David Joseph Schwartz

quotes.quote: Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
quotes.author: Oliver Goldsmith,  The Citizen of the World, Or, Letters from a Chinese Philosopher, Residing in London, to His Friends in the Country, by Dr. Goldsmith

quotes.quote: Think of success as a game of chance in which you have control over the odds. As you begin to master concepts in personal achievement, you are increasing your odds of achieving success.
quotes.author: Bo Bennett

quotes.quote: Cry. Forgive. Learn. Move on. Let your tears water the seeds of your future happiness.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: To have long term success as a coach or in any position of leadership, you have to be obsessed in some way.
quotes.author: Pat Riley

quotes.quote: Just remember: to be grateful and thank the people who are there and support you along the way is a great start to success.
quotes.author: Meryl Davis

quotes.quote: Success is a sort of metaphysical experience. I live exactly as I did before - only on a slightly bigger scale. Naturally, I won't be corrupted. I'll sit there in my Rolls, uncorrupted, and tell my chauffeur, uncorruptedly, where to go.
quotes.author: Tom Stoppard

quotes.quote: People of mediocre ability sometimes achieve outstanding success because they don't know when to quit. Most men succeed because they are determined to.
quotes.author: George Allen, Sr.

quotes.quote: Just like gold, which has to weather very high temperatures to achieve the sheen and shine it finally gets, so also every person has to go through struggles in his life to achieve success.
quotes.author: Kailash Kher

quotes.quote: Sometimes it takes a good fall to really know where you stand
quotes.author: Hayley Williams

quotes.quote: My father was overbearing. Very controlling. He was always the way he is, even before my success. He was not always a good person. He'd play mind games to make sure I knew my place. I don't see him, which is unfortunate. But I don't have any desire to see him. I vaguely know where he is, and I don't want to know.
quotes.author: Macaulay Culkin

quotes.quote: If we study learning as a data science, we can reverse engineer the human brain and tailor learning techniques to maximize the chances of student success. This is the biggest revolution that could happen in education, turning it into a data-driven science, and not such a medieval set of rumors professors tend to carry on.
quotes.author: Sebastian Thrun

quotes.quote: Success is getting what you want. Happiness is liking what you get.
quotes.author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.

quotes.quote: Entrepreneurship is like a computer game in which you have to master every level before achieving success. Startups repeatedly stumble and have to go back to the drawing board. The best way to skip some levels and to increase the odds of survival is to learn from others who have already played the game.
quotes.author: Vivek Wadhwa

quotes.quote: I can give you a six-word formula for success: Think things through - then follow through.
quotes.author: Eddie Rickenbacker

quotes.quote: One needs more than ambition and talent to make a success of anything, really. There must be love and a vocation.
quotes.author: Jessye Norman

quotes.quote: You know you are on the road to success if you would do your job, and not be paid for it.
quotes.author: Oprah Winfrey

quotes.quote: Success is due to our stretching to the challenges of life. Failure comes when we shrink from them.
quotes.author: John C. Maxwell

quotes.quote: The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
quotes.author: Walt Disney Company

quotes.quote: Success in life comes not from holding a good hand, but in playing a poor hand well.
quotes.author: Denis Waitley

quotes.quote: When it comes to success, there are no shortcuts.
quotes.author: Bo Bennett

quotes.quote: How one handles success or failure is determined by their early childhood.
quotes.author: Harold Ramis

quotes.quote: About the only problem with success is that it does not teach you how to deal with failure.
quotes.author: Tommy Lasorda

quotes.quote: Success cannot come from standstill men. Methods change and men must change with them.
quotes.author: James Cash Penney

quotes.quote: The secret to success, to parenting, to life, is to not count up the cost. Don't focus on all the steps it will take. Don't stare into the abyss at the giant leap it will take. That view will keep you from taking the next small step.
quotes.author: Regina Brett

quotes.quote: On receiving from the people the sacred trust twice confided on my illustrious predecessor, and which he has discharged so faithfully and so well, I know that I can not expect to perform the arduous task with equal ability and success.
quotes.author: Martin Van Buren

quotes.quote: You can do anything if you set your mind to it. Look out for kids, help them dream and be inspired. We teach calculus in schools, but I believe the most important formula is courage plus dreams equals success.
quotes.author: Marlee Matlin

quotes.quote: That's the key to success, isn't it? It has to be fun.
quotes.author: Monica Seles

quotes.quote: My childhood, adolescence and high school days are unusually important. If there has ever been a time that I developed a uniqueness and sense of humor and the ability to organize, it was then. In those early days, I developed the skills that gave me a certain degree of success in American politics.
quotes.author: Lee Atwater

quotes.quote: I do think a key to success in any walk of life is having a short memory and a thick skin - I know it has served me well over the years.
quotes.author: Aubrey McClendon

quotes.quote: I've worked with people at different stages of their careers and different success levels, and one thing I've noticed about the guys at the top is they're so relaxed and calm - it's about not having anything to prove except doing good work.
quotes.author: Shawn Roberts

quotes.quote: If I could offer but one helpful hint to young Hoosiers hoping to better their odds for success in life, I would simply note the importance of thoughtful reading.
quotes.author: Richard Lugar

quotes.quote: All you need in this life is ignorance and confidence; then success is sure.
quotes.author: Mark Twain

quotes.quote: Success has always been a great liar.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: Success without honor is an unseasoned dish; it will satisfy your hunger, but it won't taste good.
quotes.author: Joe Paterno

quotes.quote: I hate to be a failure. I hate and regret the failure of my marriages. I would gladly give all my millions for just one lasting marital success.
quotes.author: J. Paul Getty

quotes.quote: We just want to win. That's the bottom line. I think a lot of times people may become content with one championship or a little bit of success, but we don't really reflect on what we've done in the past. We focus on the present.
quotes.author: Derek Jeter

quotes.quote: I realise that I do not change the course of history. I am an actor, I do a movie, that's the end of it. You have to realise we are just clowns for hire. After I had success it was great, at first, not to worry about money. It was on my mind when I was growing up.
quotes.author: Leonardo DiCaprio

quotes.quote: Happy people are ignoramuses and glory is nothing else but success, and to achieve it one only has to be cunning.
quotes.author: Mikhail Lermontov

quotes.quote: All that is necessary to break the spell of inertia and frustration is this: Act as if it were impossible to fail. That is the talisman, the formula, the command of right about face which turns us from failure to success.
quotes.author: Dorothea Brande

quotes.quote: Ask yourself the secret of your success. Listen to your answer, and practice it.
quotes.author: Richard Bach

quotes.quote: That man is a success who has lived well, laughed often and loved much.
quotes.author: Robert Louis Stevenson

quotes.quote: America is the most grandiose experiment the world has seen, but, I am afraid, it is not going to be a success.
quotes.author: Sigmund Freud

quotes.quote: There is probably a perverse pride in my administration... that we were going to do the right thing, even if short-term it was unpopular. And I think anybody who's occupied this office has to remember that success is determined by an intersection in policy and politics and that you can't be neglecting of marketing and P.R. and public opinion.
quotes.author: Barack Obama

quotes.quote: You will be a failure, until you impress the subconscious with the conviction you are a success. This is done by making an affirmation which 'clicks.'
quotes.author: Florence Scovel Shinn

quotes.quote: Success and failure are equally disastrous.
quotes.author: Tennessee Williams

quotes.quote: When everything happens to you when you're so young, you're very lucky, but by the same token, you're never going to have that same feeling again. The first time anything happens to you - your first love, your first success - the second one is never the same.
quotes.author: Lauren Bacall

quotes.quote: I did stand-up comedy for 18 years. Ten of those years were spent learning, four years were spent refining, and four years were spent in wild success. I was seeking comic originality, and fame fell on me as a byproduct. The course was more plodding than heroic.
quotes.author: Steve Martin

quotes.quote: I love kite surfing and mountain bike riding. It's kind of interesting; my kite surfing ability has probably deteriorated with the rate of Kaggle's success.
quotes.author: Anthony Goldbloom

quotes.quote: Success is steady progress toward one's personal goals.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.quote: I think you can have 10,000 explanations for failure, but no good explanation for success.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho

quotes.quote: You are loved just for being who you are, just for existing. You don't have to do anything to earn it. Your shortcomings, your lack of self-esteem, physical perfection, or social and economic success - none of that matters. No one can take this love away from you, and it will always be here.
quotes.author: Ram Dass

quotes.quote: I always say be humble but be firm. Humility and openness are the key to success without compromising your beliefs.
quotes.author: George Hickenlooper

quotes.quote: Sometimes life knocks you on your ass... get up, get up, get up!!! Happiness is not the absence of problems, it's the ability to deal with them.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: The secret of my success is that I make other people money. And, never ever, ever, ever be ashamed about trying to earn as much as possible for yourself, if the person you're working with is also making money. That's life!
quotes.author: Simon Cowell

quotes.quote: I think that the reason for my success is that I am really not aspirational. I am inspirational in that the people at home feel like they can really relate to me.
quotes.author: Rosie O'Donnell

quotes.quote: Every human being is searching for a deep sense of meaning, and yet we're all chasing success. We've confused one for the other.
quotes.author: Donald Miller

quotes.quote: What is success? It is a toy balloon among children armed with pins.
quotes.author: Gene Fowler

quotes.quote: When one side benefits more than the other, that's a win-lose situation. To the winner it might look like success for a while, but in the long run, it breeds resentment and distrust.
quotes.author: Stephen Covey

quotes.quote: I've always valued and encouraged teamwork, and that collaborative spirit of we versus I is core to Intuit's success. Innovation has been part of Intuit's DNA for nearly 30 years.
quotes.author: Brad D. Smith

quotes.quote: One measure of your success will be the degree to which you build up others who work with you. While building up others, you will build up yourself.
quotes.author: James E. Casey

quotes.quote: Your positive action combined with positive thinking results in success.
quotes.author: Shiv Khera

quotes.quote: If you want to increase your success rate, double your failure rate.
quotes.author: Thomas J. Watson

quotes.quote: Hip-hop is more about attaining wealth. People respect success. They respect big. They don't even have to like your music. If you're big enough, people are drawn to you.
quotes.author: Jay-Z

quotes.quote: If I told you I've worked hard to get where I'm at, I'd be lying, because I have no idea where I am right now.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: How would your life be different if...You stopped making negative judgmental assumptions about people you encounter? Let today be the day...You look for the good in everyone you meet and respect their journey.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: I'm not after fame and success and fortune and power. It's mostly that I want to have a good job and have good friends; that's the good stuff in life.
quotes.author: Drew Barrymore

quotes.quote: After a point of time, when you get success and fame, money and everything, the purpose of life has to be redefined. For me, I think that purpose is to build bridges. Artists can do that very easily, more than politicians.
quotes.author: A. R. Rahman

quotes.quote: Forget about the consequences of failure. Failure is only a temporary change in direction to set you straight for your next success.
quotes.author: Denis Waitley

quotes.quote: I owe my success to having listened respectfully to the very best advice, and then going away and doing the exact opposite.
quotes.author: Gilbert K. Chesterton

quotes.quote: The reason we shot it was that the script was geared to Las Vegas and it was something commercial that we wanted to have in the can in case Butterfly was a success and we needed a follow-up.
quotes.author: Pia Zadora

quotes.quote: It is hard to fail, but it is worse never to have tried to succeed.
quotes.author: Theodore Roosevelt

quotes.quote: When I was working in my first job engineering construction, what I liked the most was working with architects and making buildings that had this creative side coming from the architect and that were making them a big success.
quotes.author: Bernard Arnault

quotes.quote: Some people dream of success, while other people get up every morning and make it happen.
quotes.author: Wayne Huizenga

quotes.quote: At the end of the day, you are solely responsible for your success and your failure. And the sooner you realize that, you accept that, and integrate that into your work ethic, you will start being successful. As long as you blame others for the reason you aren't where you want to be, you will always be a failure.
quotes.author: Erin Cummings

quotes.quote: Never lose sight of the fact that the most important yardstick of your success will be how you treat other people - your family, friends, and coworkers, and even strangers you meet along the way.
quotes.author: Barbara Bush

quotes.quote: If you wish to be a success in the world, promise everything, deliver nothing.
quotes.author: Napoleon Bonaparte

quotes.quote: Earn your success based on service to others, not at the expense of others.
quotes.author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.

quotes.quote: Success is peace of mind, which is a direct result of self-satisfaction in knowing you made the effort to become the best of which you are capable.
quotes.author: John Wooden

quotes.quote: Discipline is the soul of an army. It makes small numbers formidable; procures success to the weak, and esteem to all.
quotes.author: George Washington

quotes.quote: Forward, as occasion offers. Never look round to see whether any shall note it... Be satisfied with success in even the smallest matter, and think that even such a result is no trifle.
quotes.author: Marcus Aurelius

quotes.quote: A rejection is nothing more than a necessary step in the pursuit of success.
quotes.author: Bo Bennett

quotes.quote: Willpower is the key to success. Successful people strive no matter what they feel by applying their will to overcome apathy, doubt or fear.
quotes.author: Dan Millman

quotes.quote: The winner's edge is not in a gifted birth, a high IQ, or in talent. The winner's edge is all in the attitude, not aptitude. Attitude is the criterion for success.
quotes.author: Denis Waitley

quotes.quote: The new midlife is where you realize that even your failures make you more beautiful and are turned spiritually into success if you became a better person because of them. You became a more humble person. You became a more merciful and compassionate person.
quotes.author: Marianne Williamson

quotes.quote: Ambition is the path to success, persistence is the vehicle you arrive in.
quotes.author: William Eardley IV

quotes.quote: A thinker sees his own actions as experiments and questions--as attempts to find out something. Success and failure are for him answers above all.
quotes.author: Friedrich Nietzsche

quotes.quote: The level of our success is limited only by our imagination and no act of kindness, however small, is ever wasted.
quotes.author: Aesop

quotes.quote: Success is only meaningful and enjoyable if it feels like your own.
quotes.author: Michelle Obama

quotes.quote: Success is most often achieved by those who don't know that failure is inevitable.
quotes.author: Coco Chanel,  Believing in Ourselves: The Wisdom of Women

quotes.quote: Success is getting and achieving what you want. Happiness is wanting and being content with what you get.
quotes.author: Bernard Meltzer

quotes.quote: Failure is only postponed success as long as courage 'coaches' ambition. The habit of persistence is the habit of victory.
quotes.author: Herbert Kaufman

quotes.quote: No foreign policy - no matter how ingenious - has any chance of success if it is born in the minds of a few and carried in the hearts of none.
quotes.author: Henry A. Kissinger

quotes.quote: In the United States there's a Puritan ethic and a mythology of success. He who is successful is good. In Latin countries, in Catholic countries, a successful person is a sinner.
quotes.author: Umberto Eco

quotes.quote: A man is a success if he gets up in the morning and gets to bed at night, and in between he does what he wants to do.
quotes.author: Bob Dylan

quotes.quote: The only way to permanently change the temperature in the room is to reset the thermostat. In the same way, the only way to change your level of financial success 'permanently' is to reset your financial thermostat. But it is your choice whether you choose to change.
quotes.author: T. Harv Eker

quotes.quote: Whenever an individual or a business decides that success has been attained, progress stops.
quotes.author: Thomas J. Watson

quotes.quote: Success always necessitates a degree of ruthlessness. Given the choice of friendship or success, I'd probably choose success.
quotes.author: Sting

quotes.quote: Enjoy your sweat because hard work doesn't guarantee success, but without it you don't have a chance.
quotes.author: Alex Rodriguez

quotes.quote: Success is the only motivational factor that a boy with character needs.
quotes.author: Woody Hayes

quotes.quote: Success breeds complacency. Complacency breeds failure. Only the paranoid survive.
quotes.author: Andy Grove

quotes.quote: It's fine to celebrate success but it is more important to heed the lessons of failure.
quotes.author: Bill Gates

quotes.quote: The way a team plays as a whole determines its success. You may have the greatest bunch of individual stars in the world, but if they don't play together, the club won't be worth a dime.
quotes.author: Babe Ruth

quotes.quote: The only place success comes before work is in the dictionary.
quotes.author: Vince Lombardi

quotes.quote: Failure is the key to success; each mistake teaches us something.
quotes.author: Morihei Ueshiba

quotes.quote: Only those who dare to fail greatly can ever achieve greatly.
quotes.author: Robert F. Kennedy

quotes.quote: Sometimes we may ask God for success, and He gives us physical and mental stamina. We might plead for prosperity, and we receive enlarged perspective and increased patience, or we petition for growth and are blessed with the gift of grace. He may bestow upon us conviction and confidence as we strive to achieve worthy goals.
quotes.author: David A. Bednar

quotes.quote: God has already done everything He's going to do. The ball is now in your court. If you want success, if you want wisdom, if you want to be prosperous and healthy, you're going to have to do more than meditate and believe; you must boldly declare words of faith and victory over yourself and your family.
quotes.author: Joel Osteen

quotes.quote: We learned about honesty and integrity - that the truth matters... that you don't take shortcuts or play by your own set of rules... and success doesn't count unless you earn it fair and square.
quotes.author: Michelle Obama

quotes.quote: There is nothing more rare, nor more beautiful, than a woman being unapologetically herself; comfortable in her perfect imperfection. To me, that is the true essence of beauty.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: When you do what you fear most, then you can do anything.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: We learned about gratitude and humility - that so many people had a hand in our success, from the teachers who inspired us to the janitors who kept our school clean... and we were taught to value everyone's contribution and treat everyone with respect.
quotes.author: Michelle Obama

quotes.quote: Communication - the human connection - is the key to personal and career success.
quotes.author: Paul J. Meyer

quotes.quote: If you try and lose then it isn't your fault. But if you don't try and we lose, then it's all your fault.
quotes.author: Orson Scott Card,  Ender's Game

quotes.quote: A graduation ceremony is an event where the commencement speaker tells thousands of students dressed in identical caps and gowns that 'individuality' is the key to success.
quotes.author: Robert Orben

quotes.quote: Kites rise highest against the wind, not with it.
quotes.author: Winston S. Churchill

quotes.quote: Let every nation know, whether it wishes us well or ill, that we shall pay any price, bear any burden, meet any hardship, support any friend, oppose any foe to assure the survival and the success of liberty.
quotes.author: John F. Kennedy

quotes.quote: At the end of the day, the most overwhelming key to a child's success is the positive involvement of parents.
quotes.author: Jane D. Hull

quotes.quote: One important key to success is self-confidence. An important key to self-confidence is preparation.
quotes.author: Arthur Ashe

quotes.quote: The supreme quality for leadership is unquestionably integrity. Without it, no real success is possible, no matter whether it is on a section gang, a football field, in an army, or in an office.
quotes.author: Dwight D. Eisenhower

quotes.quote: Money won't create success, the freedom to make it will.
quotes.author: Nelson Mandela

quotes.quote: I don't care if you're black, white, straight, bisexual, gay, lesbian, short, tall, fat, skinny, rich or poor. If you're nice to me, I'll be nice to you. Simple as that.
quotes.author: Robert Michaels MD - 2007 - Graduation Speaker

quotes.quote: A strong, positive self-image is the best possible preparation for success.
quotes.author: Joyce Brothers

quotes.quote: At the end of the day, let there be no excuses, no explanations, no regrets.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: The best revenge is massive success.
quotes.author: Frank Sinatra

quotes.quote: Our goals can only be reached through a vehicle of a plan, in which we must fervently believe, and upon which we must vigorously act. There is no other route to success.
quotes.author: Pablo Picasso

quotes.quote: Keep your best wishes, close to your heart and watch what happens
quotes.author: Tony DeLiso,  Legacy: The Power Within

quotes.quote: The American Dream is one of success, home ownership, college education for one's children, and have a secure job to provide these and other goals.
quotes.author: Leonard Boswell

quotes.quote: We live in a world of constant juxtaposition between joy that's possible and pain that's all too common. We hope for love and success and abundance, but we never quite forget that there is always lurking the possibility of disaster.
quotes.author: Marianne Williamson

quotes.quote: Make a pact with yourself today to not be defined by your past. Sometimes the greatest thing to come out of all your hard work isn't what you get for it, but what you become for it. Shake things up today! Be You...Be Free...Share.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: I was sure I'd set the world on fire, and it was hard for a young feller like me to realize the truth - that I hadn't set the world on fire, and I was totally unprepared to handle the consequences if 'The Big Trail' had been a success and launched me as a star.
quotes.author: John Wayne

quotes.quote: For true success ask yourself these four questions: Why? Why not? Why not me? Why not now?
quotes.author: James Allen

quotes.quote: The biggest start-up successes - from Henry Ford to Bill Gates to Mark Zuckerberg - were pioneered by people from solidly middle-class backgrounds. These founders were not wealthy when they began. They were hungry for success, but knew they had a solid support system to fall back on if they failed.
quotes.author: Eric Ries

quotes.quote: Fame or perceived success - it all comes from groupthink.
quotes.author: Chance The Rapper

quotes.quote: It goes without saying that it's hard to attain a certain level of success.
quotes.author: T.I.

quotes.quote: Whenever I've had success, I never learn from it. Success usually breeds a degree of hubris. When you fail, that's when you learn.
quotes.author: Moby

quotes.quote: I'm drawn to the unconventional because I've been drawn unconventionally. I believe that I'm supposed to topple over these false images of what's idealistically beautiful. Because, of course, these intangible qualities are very attractive to women. Sincerity. Sense of humor. Success.
quotes.author: CeeLo Green

quotes.quote: Happiness is not always through success. Equally, the constant pursuit of success is sure unhappiness. But we have to find the balance. My own thoughts are that parenting is very personal. And we all feel enormous insecurity about parenting. What are they going to think of us 20 years down the line?
quotes.author: Amy Chua

quotes.quote: I'm quite detached from failure and success. Once a shooting is done, I kind of close that chapter in my life.
quotes.author: Ranbir Kapoor

quotes.quote: Achieve success in any area of life by identifying the optimum strategies and repeating them until they become habits.
quotes.author: Charles J. Givens

quotes.quote: Macro-trading requires a high degree of skill, focus and repetition. Life events, such as birth, divorce, death of a loved one and other emotional highs and lows are obstacles to success in this specific field of finance.
quotes.author: Paul Tudor Jones

quotes.quote: Success is not how many zeroes your bank account has. It's about making the most of the life you have.
quotes.author: Suze Orman

quotes.quote: Young man, the secret of my success is that an early age I discovered that I was not God.
quotes.author: Oliver Wendell Holmes, Jr.

quotes.quote: Success is the sweetest revenge.
quotes.author: Vanessa Williams

quotes.quote: I mean, we are tribal by nature, and sometimes success and material wealth can divide and separate - it's not a new philosophy I'm sharing - more than hardship, hardship tends to unify.
quotes.author: Colin Farrell

quotes.quote: Nothing good comes in life or athletics unless a lot of hard work has preceded the effort. Only temporary success is achieved by taking short cuts.
quotes.author: Roger Staubach

quotes.quote: Renew, release, let go. Yesterday's gone. There's nothing you can do to bring it back. You can't 'should've' done something. You can only DO something. Renew yourself. Release that attachment. Today is a new day!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: I think true success is intrinsic... It's love. It's kindness. It's community.
quotes.author: Tom Shadyac

quotes.quote: Comedy was my sport. It taught me how to roll with the punches. Failure is the exact same as success when it comes to comedy because it just keeps coming. It never stops.
quotes.author: Emma Stone

quotes.quote: Success means your options multiply. Size increases complexity, and complexity can confuse vision.
quotes.author: Andy Stanley

quotes.quote: Years of imprisoning and beheading writers never succeeded in shutting them out. However, placing them in the heart of a market and rewarding them with a lot of commercial success, has.
quotes.author: Arundhati Roy

quotes.quote: Personally, I don't like the term 'success.' It's too arbitrary and too relative a thing. It's usually someone else's definition, not yours.
quotes.author: Ichiro Suzuki

quotes.quote: You learn a lot about yourself when you have success for a while. Like, a lot of things that you think are really important aren't. But you need that process.
quotes.author: Curtis Jackson

quotes.quote: Fame necessarily isn't really tied to success at all. Fame is just being recognized for doing what you do, whether it's good or bad. Osama bin Laden was famous.
quotes.author: Big Sean

quotes.quote: My success is the team's success. It's one of those things to a certain degree that it's effort and ability but also how I benefit from what my teammates do, and then it is up to me to perform.
quotes.author: Jason Babin

quotes.quote: Whatever the mind can conceive and believe, it can achieve.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill,  Think and Grow Rich: A Black Choice

quotes.quote: It is no coincidence that our country has not been attacked since 9-11. Our initiatives to protect the homeland and aggressively take the fight to the terrorists have been factors in that success.
quotes.author: Roger Wicker

quotes.quote: For Nirvana, putting out their first major-label record was like getting into a new car. But the runaway success was like suddenly discovering that the car was a Ferrari and the accelerator pedal was Krazy Glued to the floorboard.
quotes.author: Michael Azerrad

quotes.quote: Spend enough time around success and failure, and you learn a reverence for possibility.
quotes.author: Dale Dauten

quotes.quote: Remember you will not always win. Some days, the most resourceful individual will taste defeat. But there is, in this case, always tomorrow - after you have done your best to achieve success today.
quotes.author: Maxwell Maltz

quotes.quote: I've come to believe that each of us has a personal calling that's as unique as a fingerprint - and that the best way to succeed is to discover what you love and then find a way to offer it to others in the form of service, working hard, and also allowing the energy of the universe to lead you.
quotes.author: Oprah Winfrey

quotes.quote: Success depends almost entirely on how effectively you learn to manage the game's two ultimate adversaries: the course and yourself.
quotes.author: Jack Nicklaus

quotes.quote: If you hang out with chickens, you're going to cluck and if you hang out with eagles, you're going to fly.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: My parents were very open about what kind of talent I had. They never pushed me to become an accountant because they knew that would be just absolutely ridiculous. So they were encouraging in what I am able to do with some success.
quotes.author: Grace Slick

quotes.quote: Forget yesterday - it has already forgotten you. Don't sweat tomorrow - you haven't even met. Instead, open your eyes and your heart to a truly precious gift - today.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Success leaves clues, and if you sow the same seeds, you'll reap the same rewards.
quotes.author: Brad Thor

quotes.quote: We are all failures- at least the best of us are.
quotes.author: J.M. Barrie

quotes.quote: I think any artist that's going to become anything in this world faces humility: with great humility comes great success.
quotes.author: Yelawolf

quotes.quote: The biggest challenge after success is shutting up about it.
quotes.author: Criss Jami

quotes.quote: Judge your success by what you had to give up in order to get it.
quotes.author: Dalai Lama XIV

quotes.quote: Start-up success is not a consequence of good genes or being in the right place at the right time. Success can be engineered by following the right process, which means it can be learned, which means it can be taught.
quotes.author: Eric Ries

quotes.quote: Success is not assured, but America is resolute: this is the best chance for peace we are likely to see for some years to come - and we are acting to help Israelis and Palestinians seize this chance.
quotes.author: Condoleezza Rice

quotes.quote: When you show yourself to the world and display your talents, you naturally stir all kinds of resentment, envy, and other manifestations of insecurity... you cannot spend your life worrying about the petty feelings of others
quotes.author: Robert Greene,  The 48 Laws of Power

quotes.quote: I think the biggest challenge is to continue on the same path. I think it's easy to become complacent from the success you've had.
quotes.author: Jason Derulo

quotes.quote: While I was doing stand-up, I thought I knew for sure that success meant getting everyone to like me. So I became whoever I thought people wanted me to be. I'd say yes when I wanted to say no, and I even wore a few dresses.
quotes.author: Ellen DeGeneres

quotes.quote: There's more to life than success, and if you can try to be more well-rounded, you'll be able to enjoy your success more. It won't own you or control you.
quotes.author: Ricky Williams

quotes.quote: Supreme excellence consists of breaking the enemy's resistance without fighting.
quotes.author: Sun Tzu,  The Art of War

quotes.quote: For marriage to be a success, every woman and every man should have her and his own bathroom. The end.
quotes.author: Catherine Zeta-Jones

quotes.quote: My story of success and failure is not just about music and being famous. It's about living and loving and trying to find purpose in this crazy world.
quotes.author: Wynonna Judd

quotes.quote: 'Perfect' is about a set-up that looks perfect from the outside - beautiful country house, beautiful wife and mother, everything where it should be - and the deep fissures that, in fact, lie beneath that. 'Perfect' was partly a response to the shock of my first book, 'The Unlikely Pilgrimage Of Harold Fry,' being a success.
quotes.author: Rachel Joyce

quotes.quote: I had the good fortune of speaking with Orson Wells many decades ago and he said 'Success is primarily luck anyway.' And I have been very lucky. Of course, Orson Wells was enormously talented and brilliant - so who am I to argue with him!
quotes.author: George Kennedy

quotes.quote: Our greatest fear should not be of failure but of succeeding at things in life that don't really matter.
quotes.author: Francis Chan,  Crazy Love: Overwhelmed by a Relentless God

quotes.quote: Always bear in mind that your own resolution to succeed is more important than any one thing.
quotes.author: Abraham Lincoln

quotes.quote: No man is a success in business unless he loves his work.
quotes.author: Florence Scovel Shinn

quotes.quote: Education is a fundamental principle of what made America a success. We can't afford to throw any young people away.
quotes.author: Ben Carson

quotes.quote: All I can say is that I have arrived with the desire to be a success at Barca, that I am hungry to win titles.
quotes.author: Luis Suarez

quotes.quote: Success in training the boy depends largely on the Scoutmaster's own personal example.
quotes.author: Robert Baden-Powell

quotes.quote: I find the best way to love someone is not to change them, but instead, help them reveal the greatest version of themselves.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: You lead with direction, and you try to lead by example. I try to be there when things are not good and obviously share the spoils of success.
quotes.author: Roger Penske

quotes.quote: Don't be afraid of failure; be afraid of petty success.
quotes.author: Maude Adams

quotes.quote: Success produces confidence; confidence relaxes industry, and negligence ruins the reputation which accuracy had raised.
quotes.author: Ben Jonson

quotes.quote: You're not obligated to win. You're obligated to keep trying. To the best you can do everyday.

quotes.quote: Although time seems to fly, it never travels faster than one day at a time. Each day is a new opportunity to live your life to the fullest.
