quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Stop trying to 'fix' yourself; you're NOT broken! You are perfectly imperfect and powerful beyond measure.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Don't let mental blocks control you. Set yourself free. Confront your fear and turn the mental blocks into building blocks.
quotes.author: Roopleen,  Words to inspire the winner in YOU

quotes.quote: Without an open-minded mind, you can never be a great success.
quotes.author: Martha Stewart

quotes.quote: What seems to us as bitter trials are often blessings in disguise
quotes.author: Oscar Wilde

quotes.quote: Find a purpose to serve, not a lifestyle to live.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Venus in Arms

quotes.quote: We dissect failure a lot more than we dissect success.
quotes.author: Matthew McConaughey

quotes.quote: You may be disappointed if you fail, but you are doomed if you don't try.
quotes.author: Beverly Sills

quotes.quote: It's what you do in your free time that will set you free--or enslave you.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Title is Invisible

quotes.quote: Instead of this confusion, we need the unifying force of an official language, English, which is the language of success in America.
quotes.author: Ernest Istook

quotes.quote: Judging is preventing us from understanding a new truth. Free yourself from the rules of old judgments and create the space for new understanding.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: The greatest love stories are not those in which love is only spoken, but those in which it is acted upon.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: I don't take success very well, because I know it's fleeting. And the next day, it can all fall apart. I know that, too. So I don't get too high, and I don't get too low. You get through the world a lot easier that way.
quotes.author: James Garner

quotes.quote: Doing the best at this moment puts you in the best place for the mext moment
quotes.author: Oprah Winfrey

quotes.quote: The test of success is not what you do when you are on top. Success is how high you bounce when you hit the bottom.
quotes.author: George S. Patton Jr.

quotes.quote: My second book, Follow Me Down had some success, got good critical notices, went into a second printing and things like that, but Shiloh was by far the most successful of those first five novels.
quotes.author: Shelby Foote

quotes.quote: Happy people produce. Bored people consume.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: Don't blow off another's candle for it won't make yours shine brighter.
quotes.author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

quotes.quote: My parents told me that education was the path to success - and they showed me, taking me to Head Start while they were pursuing their own college degrees.
quotes.author: Denise Juneau

quotes.quote: Our way of thinking creates good or bad outcomes.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: My dad told me, 'It takes fifteen years to be an overnight success', and it took me seventeen and a half years.
quotes.author: Adrien Brody

quotes.quote: It's failure that gives you the proper perspective on success.
quotes.author: Ellen DeGeneres,  Seriously... I'm Kidding

quotes.quote: If you have a successful run, everything comes to you. Nothing succeeds like success.
quotes.author: John Barry

quotes.quote: If you're in the luckiest one per cent of humanity, you owe it to the rest of humanity to think about the other 99 per cent.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett

quotes.quote: Seeking an acquisition from the start is more than just bad advice for an entrepreneur. For the entrepreneur it leads to short term tactical decisions rather than company-building decisions and in my view often reduces the probability of success.
quotes.author: Vinod Khosla

quotes.quote: If you fuel your journey on the opinions of others, you are going to run out of gas.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Refuse to accept the belief that your professional relevance, career success or financial security turns on the next update on the latest technology. Sometimes it's good to put the paddle down and just let the canoe glide.
quotes.author: Simon Mainwaring

quotes.quote: Each new day is a blank page in the diary of your life. The secret of success is in turning that diary into the best story you possibly can.
quotes.author: Douglas Pagels

quotes.quote: Love yourself. Forgive yourself. Be true to yourself. How you treat yourself sets the standard for how others will treat you.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: The freedom to fail is vital if you're going to succeed. Most successful people fail from time to time, and it is a measure of their strength that failure merely propels them into some new attempt at success.
quotes.author: Michael Korda

quotes.quote: Fear can only grow in darkness. Once you face fear with light, you win.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Sometimes, because of my success, I am afraid that I was not a good father. With the first two I was too strong, and with the other three I was too weak.
quotes.author: Roberto Cavalli

quotes.quote: All the time you're saying to yourself, 'I could do that, but I won't,' -- which is just another way of saying that you can't.
quotes.author: Richard Feynman,  Surely You're Joking, Mr. Feynman!: Adventures of a Curious Character

quotes.quote: Do not sabotage your new relationship with your last relationship's poison.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Inherited Will, The Destiny of the Age, and The Dreams of the People. As long as people continue to pursue the meaning of Freedom, these things will never cease to be!"- Gol D. Roger
quotes.author: Eiichiro Oda

quotes.quote: You have a unique gift to offer this world. Be true to yourself, be kind to yourself, read and learn about everything that interests you and keep away from people who bring you down. When you treat yourself kindly and respect the uniqueness of those around you, you will be giving this world an amazing gift... YOU!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: It's the price of success: people start to think you're omnipotent.
quotes.author: Ben Bernanke

quotes.quote: Act the way you'd like to be and soon you'll be the way you'd like to act.
quotes.author: Bob Dylan

quotes.quote: I believe we can accelerate our acumen, performance and success by leveraging our associations and spending time with people better than us.
quotes.author: Robin S. Sharma

quotes.quote: When your back is to the wall and you are facing fear head on, the only way is forward and through it.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards,  Releasing You from Fear

quotes.quote: No matter what your history has been, your destiny is what you create today. What are you going to create?
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Doubt kills more dreams than failure ever will.
quotes.author: Suzy Kassem

quotes.quote: Men are born to succeed, not to fail.
quotes.author: Henry David Thoreau

quotes.quote: Put your heart, mind, and soul into even your smallest acts. This is the secret of success.
quotes.author: Swami Sivananda

quotes.quote: I always envisioned myself being a rapper and being in the game and having success, but you never know what it feels like or how you're going to be when you're there.
quotes.author: Wiz Khalifa

quotes.quote: Judgment is a negative frequency.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: The way of success is the way of continuous pursuit of knowledge.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill,  Think and Grow Rich

quotes.quote: The victim mindset dilutes the human potential. By not accepting personal responsibility for our circumstances, we greatly reduce our power to change them.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: The best revenge in the world is success.
quotes.author: Suge Knight

quotes.quote: Fame is something that is bestowed upon you because of success. Success is something you have to chase.
quotes.author: Noel Gallagher

quotes.quote: Success will be within your reach only when you start reaching out for it.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

quotes.quote: I like the idea of working in different genres and transcending genres and hopefully finding success, and ultimately make movies people like.
quotes.author: Dwayne Johnson

quotes.quote: You can't just wish change; you have to live the change in order for it to become a reality.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: To be heroic is to be courageous enough to die for something; to be inspirational is to be crazy enough to live a little.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Venus in Arms

quotes.quote: Decide what you want to be....Pay the Price ...And be what you want to be.
quotes.author: John Andreas Widtsoe,  In a Sunlit Land

quotes.quote: Every single time you help somebody stand up you are helping humanity rise.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Success is fickle, but creativity is a gift.
quotes.author: Tommy Shaw

quotes.quote: Don't give up! It's not over. The universe is balanced. Every set-back bears with it the seeds of a come-back.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Your life is a print-out of your thoughts.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: I do not like to repeat successes I like to go on to other things.
quotes.author: Walt Disney Company

quotes.quote: Are you going to allow the world around you to change while you remain stagnant? Make this the time you throw away old habits that have hindered your happiness and success and finally allow your greatest self to flourish.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Strike the shepherd and the sheep will scatter
quotes.author: Robert Greene,  The 48 Laws of Power

quotes.quote: Our limitations and success will be based, most often, on your own expectations for ourselves. What the mind dwells upon, the body acts upon.
quotes.author: Denis Waitley

quotes.quote: To succeed in the world it is not enough to be stupid - one must also be polite.
quotes.author: Voltaire

quotes.quote: Don't let what you cannot do interfere with what you can do.
quotes.author: John Wooden

quotes.quote: You may be the only person left who believes in you, but it's enough. It takes just one star to pierce a universe of darkness. Never give up.
quotes.author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Smile Anyway: Quotes, Verse, & Grumblings for Every Day of the Year

quotes.quote: If you look at anyone who has achieved great success and wealth, people like Warren Buffett, Oprah Winfrey, or Lance Armstrong, they have all focused intensely in order to win.
quotes.author: Robert Kiyosaki

quotes.quote: There are going to be times when you learn more about the world you're entering and feel defeated when you see the gap between the ideal and the reality... But that's something we'll all face. The people that face those obstacles and overcome them are people whose dreams come true.
quotes.author: Tsugumi Ohba,  Bakuman, Volume 3: Debut and Impatience

quotes.quote: If you can't do great things, Mother Teresa used to say, do little things with great love. If you can't do them with great love, do them with a little love. If you can't do them with a little love, do them anyway.Love grows when people serve.
quotes.author: John Ortberg,  The Me I Want to Be: Becoming God's Best Version of You

quotes.quote: The only guarantee for failure is to stop trying
quotes.author: John C. Maxwell

quotes.quote: It's a lack of clarity that creates chaos and frustration. Those emotions are poison to any living goal.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: How would your life be different if...You pretended those around you were deaf to your words? Let today be the day...You let your actions speak and communicate your feelings and intentions.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: In every stump speech I give, I speak about the fact that people who dream and achieve enormous success do not make us poorer - they make us better off.
quotes.author: Mitt Romney

quotes.quote: Act as if! Act as if you're a wealthy man, rich already, and then you'll surely become rich. Act as if you have unmatched confidence and then people will surely have confidence in you. Act as if you have unmatched experience and then people will follow your advice. And act as if you are already a tremendous success, and as sure as I stand here today - you will become successful.
quotes.author: Jordan Belfort,  The Wolf of Wall Street

quotes.quote: When you are living the best version of yourself, you inspire others to live the best versions of themselves.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Don't worry about being effective. Just concentrate on being faithful to the truth.
quotes.author: Dorothy Day

quotes.quote: No matter how small you start, always dream big.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: If your success is not on your own terms, if it looks good to the world but does not feel good in your heart, it is not success at all.
quotes.author: Anna Quindlen

quotes.quote: There are no secrets to success: don't waste time looking for them. Success is the result of perfection, hard work, learning from failure, loyalty to those for whom you work, and persistence.
quotes.author: Colin Powell

quotes.quote: You've achieved success in your field when you don't know whether what you're doing is work or play.
quotes.author: Warren Beatty

quotes.quote: I am struck by how sharing our weakness and difficulties is more nourishing to others than sharing our qualities and successes.
quotes.author: Jean Vanier,  Community And Growth

quotes.quote: I have found no greater satisfaction than achieving success through honest dealing and strict adherence to the view that, for you to gain, those you deal with should gain as well.
quotes.author: Alan Greenspan

quotes.quote: A quitter never wins-and-a winner never quits.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill,  Think and Grow Rich

quotes.quote: The merit of all things lies in their difficulty.
quotes.author: Alexandre Dumas,  The Three Musketeers

quotes.quote: I am not a victim. No matter what I have been through, I'm still here. I have a history of victory.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Before you can successfully make friends with others, first you have to become your own friend.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: The real glory is being knocked to your knees and then coming back. That's real glory. Thats the essence of it.
quotes.author: Vince Lombardi Jr.

quotes.quote: Success is the doing, not the getting; in the trying, not the triumph. Success is a personal standard, reaching for the highest that is in us, becoming all that we can be. If we do our best, we are a success.
quotes.author: Zig Ziglar

quotes.quote: But I think it's more normal for my team to have no success than it is to win two consecutive European cups.
quotes.author: Jose Mourinho

quotes.quote: The way to screw up somebody's life is to give them what they want.
quotes.author: Patrick Swayze

quotes.quote: People don't need love. What they need is success in one form or another. It can be love but it needn't be.
quotes.author: Charles Bukowski,  Factotum

quotes.quote: Do not sit still; start moving now. In the beginning, you may not go in the direction you want, but as long as you are moving, you are creating alternatives and possibilities.
quotes.author: Rodolfo Costa,  Advice My Parents Gave Me: and Other Lessons I Learned from My Mistakes

quotes.quote: Sure it could get rough sometimes, but life wasn't a Hollywood movie. Shit happened. You fought, you screamed, and somehow you worked like hell to get out the other side still intact.
quotes.author: Samantha Young,  On Dublin Street

quotes.quote: The power behind taking responsibility for your actions lies in putting an end to negative thought patterns. You no longer dwell on what went wrong or focus on whom you are going to blame. You don't waste time building roadblocks to your success. Instead, you are set free and can now focus on succeeding.
quotes.author: Lorii Myers

quotes.quote: Anyone who imagines they can work alone winds up surrounded by nothing but rivals, without companions. The fact is, no one ascends alone.
quotes.author: Lance Armstrong,  It's Not About the Bike: My Journey Back to Life

quotes.quote: Failure should be our teacher, not our undertaker. Failure is delay, not defeat. It is a temporary detour, not a dead end. Failure is something we can avoid only by saying nothing, doing nothing, and being nothing.
quotes.author: Denis Waitley

quotes.quote: The world's greatest achievers have been those who have always stayed focussed on their goals and have been consistent in their efforts.
quotes.author: Roopleen,  Words to inspire the winner in YOU

quotes.quote: There is no scientific answer for success. You can't define it. You've simply got to live it and do it.
quotes.author: Anita Roddick

quotes.quote: Life always begins with one step outside of your comfort zone.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: The road to success is dotted with many tempting parking spaces.
quotes.author: Will Rogers

quotes.quote: Everyone has determination - it's a question of how you use it. Hers is based on power and success and conquering; she doesn't care what she has to do or who gets hurt in the process. In that way we're very, very different.
quotes.author: Dannii Minogue

quotes.quote: Happiness is something we reap from the seeds we sow. Plant misery seeds and that us what you reap.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

quotes.quote: Missing a train is only painful if you run after it! Likewise, not matching the idea of success others expect from you is only painful if that's what you are seeking.
quotes.author: Nassim Nicholas Taleb,  The Black Swan: The Impact of the Highly Improbable

quotes.quote: Become the leader of your life. Lead yourself to where you want to be. Breathe life back into your ambitions, your desires, your goals, your relationships.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: When you know what you want, and you want it bad enough, you'll find a way to get it.
quotes.author: Jim Rohn

quotes.quote: Don't set your goals by what other people deem important.
quotes.author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

quotes.quote: Success is not obtained overnight. It comes in installments; you get a little bit today, a little bit tomorrow until the whole package is given out. The day you procrastinate, you lose that day's success.
quotes.author: Israelmore Ayivor

quotes.quote: To design the future effectively, you must first let go of your past.
quotes.author: Charles J. Givens

quotes.quote: I was taught to strive not because there were any guarantees of success but because the act of striving is in itself the only way to keep faith with life.
quotes.author: Madeleine Albright,  Madam Secretary: A Memoir

quotes.quote: Your success and happiness lie in you.
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.quote: Never allow the fear of striking out keep you from playing the game!
quotes.author: Babe Ruth

quotes.quote: The whole secret of a successful life is to find out what is one's destiny to do, and then do it.
quotes.author: Henry Ford

quotes.quote: You have been blessed with immeasurable power to make positive changes in your life.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Do not dilute the truth of your potential. We often convince ourselves that we cannot change, that we cannot overcome the circumstances of our lives. That is simply not true. You have been blessed with immeasurable power to make positive changes in your life. But you can't just wish it, you can't just hope it, you can't just want it... you have to LIVE it, BE it, DO it.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Cultivate an optimistic mind, use your imagination, always consider alternatives, and dare to believe that you can make possible what others think is impossible.
quotes.author: Rodolfo Costa,  Advice My Parents Gave Me: and Other Lessons I Learned from My Mistakes

quotes.quote: We fall forward to succeed.
quotes.author: Mary Kay Ash

quotes.quote: No other success can compensate for failure in the home.
quotes.author: J. E. McCulloch

quotes.quote: You've been given the innate power to shape your life...but you cannot just speak change, you have to LIVE change. Intent paired with action builds the bridge to success. You can't just want it; you have to do it, live it...BE it! Success isn't something you have, it's something you DO!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: Don't be afraid of failure. This is the way to succeed.
quotes.author: LeBron James,  Shooting Stars

quotes.quote: Success is like death. The more successful you become, the higher the houses in the hills get and the higher the fences get.
quotes.author: Kevin Spacey

quotes.quote: ...it is well known that a vital ingredient of success is not knowing that what you're attempting can't be done.
quotes.author: Terry Pratchett,  Equal Rites

quotes.quote: You're frustrated because you keep waiting for the blooming of flowers of which you have yet to sow the seeds.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: He will know from and early age that failure is not disgrace. It's just a pitch that you missed, and you'd better get ready for the next one. The next one might be the shot heard round the world. My son and I are Americans, we prepare for glory by failing until we don't.
quotes.author: Craig Ferguson,  American on Purpose: The Improbable Adventures of an Unlikely Patriot

quotes.quote: Success consists of getting up just one more time than you fall.

quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: Life itself is simple...it's just not easy.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Pretend that every single person you meet has a sign around his or her neck that says, "Make me feel important."Not only will you succeed in sales, you will succeed in life.
quotes.author: Mary Kay Ash

quotes.quote: If you're not gonna go all the way, why go at all?
quotes.author: Joe Namath

quotes.quote: The success and the failure are not my concern, but His.
quotes.author: Joseph Barber Lightfoot

quotes.quote: I am so grateful for my troubles. As I reflect back on my life, I have come to realize that my greatest triumphs have been born of my greatest troubles.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Believing in negative thoughts is the single greatest obstruction to success.
quotes.author: Charles F. Glassman,  Brain Drain The Breakthrough That Will Change Your Life

quotes.quote: You are where you are right now because of the actions you've taken, or maybe, the inaction you've taken.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Stop giving meaningless praise and start giving meaningful action.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Edit your life frequently and ruthlessly. It's your masterpiece after all.
quotes.author: Nathan W. Morris

quotes.quote: Success is the space one occupies in the newspaper. Success is one day's insolence.
quotes.author: Elias Canetti

quotes.quote: You are forgiven for your happiness and your successes only if you generously consent to share them.
quotes.author: Albert Camus

quotes.quote: Pray that success will not come any faster than you are able to endure it.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: The only real battle in life is between hanging on and letting go.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: The line between failure and success is so fine. . . that we are often on the line and do not know it.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: Prospering just doesn't have to do with money.
quotes.author: Joel Osteen

quotes.quote: Learn from your history, but don't live in it.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: I never fail. It's just that the people around me succeed more than I.
quotes.author: Carroll Bryant

quotes.quote: The bottom line is, insults only hurt when they come from someone I respect.
quotes.author: Kresley Cole

quotes.quote: Courage to me is doing something daring, no matter how afraid, insecure, intimidated, alone, unworthy, incapable, ridiculed or whatever other paralyzing emotion you might feel. Courage is taking action.....no matter what. So you're afraid? Be afraid. Be scared silly to the point you're trembling and nauseous, but do it anyway!
quotes.author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Smile Anyway: Quotes, Verse, & Grumblings for Every Day of the Year

quotes.quote: Stop blaming outside circumstances for your inside chaos.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Well, if it can be thought, it can be done, a problem can be overcome,
quotes.author: E.A. Bucchianeri,  Brushstrokes of a Gadfly

quotes.quote: Nearly' only counts in horseshoes and hand-grenades.
quotes.author: Neil Gaiman,  The Graveyard Book

quotes.quote: I cannot say this too strongly: Do not compare yourselves to others. Be true to who you are, and continue to learn with all your might.
quotes.author: Daisaku Ikeda,  Discussions on Youth

quotes.quote: Sky is not a limit for me; because I have no limit for myself in life. Because life is a world full of risk taking and possibilities. No matter how hard or easy life is; I will always find a way to enjoy myself; even in the mist of circumstances; because problems is a sense of adventure in sheep's clothing.
quotes.author: Temitope Owosela

quotes.quote: According to the moral absolutism that characterizes McCandless's beliefs, a challenge in which a successful outcome is assured isn't a challenge at all.
quotes.author: Jon Krakauer,  Into the Wild

quotes.quote: Success to me is having ten honeydew melons and eating only the top half of each slice.
quotes.author: Barbra Streisand

quotes.quote: We set out to save the Shire, Sam and it has been saved - but not for me.
quotes.author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Return of the King

quotes.quote: I dreamt -- marvellous error! -- that I had a beehive here inside my heart. And the golden bees were making white combs and sweet honey from my old failures.
quotes.author: Antonio Machado

quotes.quote: Take your victories, whatever they may be, cherish them, use them, but don't settle for them.
quotes.author: Mia Hamm

quotes.quote: Those who don't jump will never fly.
quotes.author: Leena Ahmad Almashat,  Harmony Letters

quotes.quote: Success doesn't mean that you are healthy, success doesn't mean that you're happy, success doesn't mean that you're rested. Success really doesn't mean that you look good, or feel good, or are good.
quotes.author: Victoria Principal

quotes.quote: When you live your life by poor standards, you inflict damage on everyone who crosses your path, especially those you love.
quotes.author: Jordan Belfort

quotes.quote: When you go in search of honey, you must expect to be stung by bees.
quotes.author: Joseph Joubert

quotes.quote: Success is getting what you want; happiness is wanting what you get.
quotes.author: Ingrid Bergman

quotes.quote: One of the lessons that I grew up with was to always stay true to yourself and never let what somebody else says distract you from your goals. And so when I hear about negative and false attacks, I really don't invest any energy in them, because I know who I am.
quotes.author: Michelle Obama

quotes.quote: There is only one success-to be able to spend life in your own way.
quotes.author: Christopher Morley

quotes.quote: From success you get a lot of things, but not that great inside thing that love brings you.
quotes.author: Samuel Goldwyn

quotes.quote: The backbone of success is...hard work, determination, good planning, and perserverence.
quotes.author: Mia Hamm

quotes.quote: We have forty million reasons for failure, but not a single excuse.
quotes.author: Rudyard Kipling

quotes.quote: Never run from the enemy, tackle them
quotes.author: Victoria Addino

quotes.quote: Like poetry, fashion does not state anything. It merely suggests
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.quote: Who you are tomorrow begins with what you do today.
quotes.author: Tim Fargo

quotes.quote: We live in a system that espouses merit, equality, and a level playing field, but exalts those with wealth, power, and celebrity, however gained.
quotes.author: Derrick A. Bell,  Ethical Ambition: Living a Life of Meaning and Worth

quotes.quote: Success is the result of perfection, hard work, learning from failure, loyalty, and persistence.
quotes.author: Colin Powell

quotes.quote: At any given moment the choice to be happy is present- we just have to choose to be happy.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Free yourself from the burden of feeling the need to hold on to anything. Let go... you are a part of everything.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Failure is a greater teacher than success
quotes.author: Clarissa Pinkola EstÃ©s,  Women Who Run With the Wolves: Myths and Stories of the Wild Woman Archetype

quotes.quote: Fashion does not have to prove that it is serious. It is the proof that intelligent frivolity can be something creative and positive
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.quote: Lack of confidence, sometimes alternating with unrealistic dreams of heroic success, often leads to procrastination, and many studies suggest that procrastinators are self-handicappers: rather than risk failure, they prefer to create conditions that make success impossible, a reflex that of course creates a vicious cycle.
quotes.author: James Surowiecki

quotes.quote: The secret to success is constancy of purpose.
quotes.author: Benjamin Disraeli

quotes.quote: NEVER be surprised by your own success!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: When you fail, that is when you get closer to success.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: It's not about working for money, it's about having money work for you.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: Fortunate are those who take the first steps.
quotes.author: Paulo Coelho,  By the River Piedra I Sat Down and Wept

quotes.quote: There's no reason to have a plan B because it distracts from plan A.
quotes.author: Will Smith

quotes.quote: We may place blame, give reasons, and even have excuses; but in the end, it is an act of cowardice to not follow your dreams.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: It is a common condition of being poor...you are always afraid that the good things in your life are temporary, that someone can take them away, because you have no power beyond your own brute strength to stop them.
quotes.author: Rick Bragg

quotes.quote: Your life begins to change the day you take responsibility for it.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: God's word is not just to be heard and repeated, it is to be breathed, lived, and emulated with each action.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Perfection' is man's ultimate illusion. It simply doesn't exist in the universe.... If you are a perfectionist, you are guaranteed to be a loser in whatever you do.
quotes.author: David D. Burns

quotes.quote: Make the choice to embrace this day. Do not let your TODAY be stolen by the ghost of yesterday or the "To-Do"list of tomorrow! It's inspiring to see all the wonderfully amazing things that can happen in a day in which you participate.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: As Aristotle said, 'Excellence is a habit.' I would say furthermore that excellence is made constant through the feeling that comes right after one has completed a work which he himself finds undeniably awe-inspiring. He only wants to relax until he's ready to renew such a feeling all over again because to him, all else has become absolutely trivial.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Our business in life is not to succeed, but to continue to fail in good spirits.
quotes.author: Robert Louis Stevenson

quotes.quote: I peed on the floor to get hired. Now I'm the janitor.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  The Titanic would never have sunk if it were made out of a sink.

quotes.quote: It doesn't matter how great your shoes are if you don't accomplish anything in them.
quotes.author: Martina Boone,  Compulsion

quotes.quote: Be an opener of doors
quotes.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

quotes.quote: There are no secrets to success. It is the result of preparation, hard work, and learning from failure.
quotes.author: Colin Powell

quotes.quote: You rarely win, but sometimes you do.
quotes.author: Harper Lee

quotes.quote: You cannot continue on the same path and arrive at a different destination. Make the choice to have your actions reflect your goals.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Stop allowing your day-to-day life to be clouded by busy nothingness.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: While intent is the seed of manifestation, action is the water that nourishes the seed. Your actions must reflect your goals in order to achieve true success.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: No guts, no story.
quotes.author: Chris Brady

quotes.quote: Don't wait for other people to be loving, giving, compassionate, grateful, forgiving, generous, or friendly... lead the way!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: You only have to do a very few things right in your life so long as you don't do too many things wrong.
quotes.author: Warren Buffett

quotes.quote: If you don't know exactly where you're going, how will you know when you get there?
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Don't be afraid to give up the good to go for the great.
quotes.author: John D. Rockefeller

quotes.quote: The most important thing is this: to sacrifice what you are now for what you can become tomorrow.
quotes.author: Shannon L. Alder

quotes.quote: For success, attitude is equally as important as ability.
quotes.author: Walter Scott

quotes.quote: There is absolutely no greater high than challenging the power structure as a nobody, giving it your all, and winning!
quotes.author: Abbie Hoffman

quotes.quote: Your dream is a reality that is waiting for you to materialize. Today is a new day! Don't let your history interfere with your destiny! Learn from your past so that it can empower your present and propel you to greatness
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: With one day's reading a man may have the key in his hands.
quotes.author: Ezra Pound

quotes.quote: Live your vision and demand your success.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: So, I must be taken as I have been made. The success is not mine, the failure is not mine, but the two together make me.
quotes.author: Charles Dickens,  Great Expectations

quotes.quote: Humility is the true key to success. Successful people lose their way at times. They often embrace and overindulge from the fruits of success. Humility halts this arrogance and self-indulging trap. Humble people share the credit and wealth, remaining focused and hungry to continue the journey of success.
quotes.author: Rick Pitino

quotes.quote: If you really want the key to success, start by doing the opposite of what everyone else is doing.
quotes.author: Brad Szollose

quotes.quote: Learn to adapt. Things change, circumstances change. Adjust yourself and your efforts to what it is presented to you so you can respond accordingly. Never see change as a threat, because it can be an opportunity to learn, to grow, evolve and become a better person.
quotes.author: Rodolfo Costa,  Advice My Parents Gave Me: and Other Lessons I Learned from My Mistakes

quotes.quote: If you want to find happiness, find gratitude.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Participate in your dreams today. There are unlimited opportunities available with this new day. Take action on those wonderful dreams you've had in your mind for so long. Remember, success is something you experience when you act accordingly.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: How many people you bless is how you measure success
quotes.author: Rick Ross

quotes.quote: Stop just cheering for others who are living their visions. Commit yourself to your own success and follow the steps required to achieve it.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Stop pointing fingers and placing blame on others. Your life can only change to the degree that you accept responsibility for it.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Today, many will choose to live free of conditions and rules governing their own happiness. Why not you? Do not let another day go by where your dedication to other people's opinions is greater than your dedication to your own emotions! Today's a new day!
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Stop waiting for the perfect day or the perfect moment... Take THIS day, THIS moment and lead it to perfection.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

But writing is about struggling through and learning and finding out what it is about writing itself that you really love.
quotes.author: Laura Kasischke

quotes.quote: If you think you can then you can.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: Go as far as you can see and you will see further.

quotes.quote: Without continual growth and progress, such words as improvement, achievement, and success have no meaning.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.quote: The power to change your life lies in the simplest of steps.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: Most men either compromise or drop their greatest talents and start running after, what they perceive to be, a more reasonable success, and somewhere in between they end up with a discontented settlement. Safety is indeed stability, but it is not progression.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Why are you going to choose failure when success is an option?
quotes.author: Jillian Michaels

quotes.quote: A person who doubts himself is like a man who would enlist in the ranks of his enemies and bear arms against himself. He makes his failures certain by himself being the first person to be convinced of it.
quotes.author: Alexandre Dumas

quotes.quote: It is safer to search in the maze than to remain in a cheeseless situation
quotes.author: Spencer Johnson,  Who Moved My Cheese?

quotes.quote: When you experience a negative circumstance or event, do not dwell on it. Be proactive -- put your attention on what you need to do to bring the situation to a positive result.
quotes.author: Rodolfo Costa,  Advice My Parents Gave Me: and Other Lessons I Learned from My Mistakes

quotes.quote: Happiness simply cannot be relied upon as a measure of success.
quotes.author: John C. Maxwell,  Your Road Map for Success: You Can Get There from Here

quotes.quote: The universe doesn't give you what you want in your mind; it gives you what you demand with your actions.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Interrupt your thoughts of "I should", with your action of doing.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: The secret of success in life is for a man to be ready for his opportunity when it comes.
quotes.author: Benjamin Disraeli

quotes.quote: One may not always know his purpose until his only option is to monopolize in what he truly excels at. He grows weary of hearing the answer 'no' time and time again, so he turns to and cultivates, monopolizes in his one talent which others cannot possibly subdue. Then, beyond the crowds of criticism and rejection, the right people recognize his talent - among them he finds his stage.
quotes.author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

quotes.quote: Each new friend gives rise to the possibility of anything!
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: Sure I am this day we are masters of our fate, that the task which has been set before us is not above our strength; that its pangs and toils are not beyond our endurance. As long as we have faith in our own cause and an unconquerable will to win, victory will not be denied us.
quotes.author: Winston S. Churchill

quotes.quote: Success is not a destination, but the road that you're on. Being successful means that you're working hard and walking your walk every day. You can only live your dream by working hard towards it. That's living your dream.
quotes.author: Marlon Wayans

quotes.quote: Play around. Dive into absurdity and write. Take chances. You will succeed if you are fearless of failure.
quotes.author: Natalie Goldberg,  Writing Down the Bones: Freeing the Writer Within

quotes.quote: Although goals are important, having a plan of action is vital to the success of those goals. Having a goal with no plan of action is like wanting to travel to a new destination without having a map.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: The bird dares to break the shell, then the shell breaks open and the bird can fly openly. This is the simplest principle of success. You dream, you dare and and you fly.
quotes.author: Israelmore Ayivor

quotes.quote: Sometimes not getting what you want is a brilliant stroke of luck.
quotes.author: Lorii Myers,  Make It Happen, A Healthy, Competitive Approach to Achieving Personal Success

quotes.quote: Success is the progressive realization of a worthy ideal
quotes.author: Thomas S. Monson

quotes.quote: To become successful, one must put themselves in the paths of giants!
quotes.author: Lillian Cauldwell

quotes.quote: Almost anyone can be an author; the business is to collect money and fame from this state of being.
quotes.author: A.A. Milne,  Not That It Matters

quotes.quote: You will find the key to success under the alarm clock.
quotes.author: Benjamin Franklin

quotes.quote: Sometimes success demands a certain refined insanity.
quotes.author: Isobelle Carmody,  The Keeping Place

quotes.quote: Never feel shame for trying and failing for he who has never failed is he who has never tried.
quotes.author: Og Mandino,  The Greatest Salesman in the World

quotes.quote: Character cannot be developed in ease and quiet. Only through experience of trial and suffering can the soul be strengthened, ambition inspired, and success achieved.
quotes.author: Helen Keller

quotes.quote: Be patient. Your skin took a while to deteriorate. Give it some time to reflect a calmer inner state. As one of my friends states on his Facebook profile: "The true Losers in Life, are not those who Try and Fail, but those who Fail to Try.
quotes.author: Jess C. Scott,  Clear: A Guide to Treating Acne Naturally

quotes.quote: Remember, happiness doesn't depend upon who you are or what you have; it depends solely upon what you think. So start each day by thinking of all the things you have to be thankful for. Your future will depend very largely on the thoughts you think today. So think thoughts of hope and confidence and love and success.
quotes.author: Dale Carnegie

quotes.quote: Be a King. Dare to be Different, dare to manifest your greatness.
quotes.author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

quotes.quote: Your agreement with reality defines your life.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: I will eliminate hatred, envy, jealousy, selfishness, and cynicism, by developing love for all humanity, because I know that a negative attitude toward others can never bring me success. I will cause others to believe in me, because I will believe in them, and in myself.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill,  Think and Grow Rich

quotes.quote: Start shaping your own day. Start walking your own walk. This journey is yours, take charge of it. Stop giving other people the power to shape your life.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: The empowered woman is powerful beyond measure and beautiful beyond description.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Whole life is a search for beauty. But, when the beauty is found inside, the search ends and a beautiful journey begins.
quotes.author: Harshit Walia

quotes.quote: Do I attribute my success to hard work, or sunscreen? If you want the truth, maybe you should ask my new albino secretary.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  At even one penny, this book would be overpriced. In fact, free is too expensive, because you'd still waste time by reading it.

quotes.quote: When we give up the chase, we give up our wishing.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: The road to success is not easy to navigate, but with hard work, drive and passion, it's possible to achieve the American dream.
quotes.author: Tommy Hilfiger

quotes.quote: Today is the only day in which we have any power.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: You are beautiful. Your beauty, just like your capacity for life, happiness, and success, is immeasurable.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Stuff your brain with knowledge.
quotes.author: Karl Lagerfeld

quotes.quote: Moods can be contagious. Don't catch or spread a bad mood.
quotes.author: Marilyn Suttle

quotes.quote: If you want to give yourself a fair chance to succeed, never expect too much too soon
quotes.author: Po Bronson

quotes.quote: Early success is a terrible teacher. You're essentially being rewarded for a lack of preparation, so when you find yourself in a situation where you must prepare, you can't do it. You don't know how.
quotes.author: Chris Hadfield,  An Astronaut's Guide to Life on Earth

quotes.quote: Don't tie your success to anything other than what's inside you
quotes.author: Debra Anastasia,  Poughkeepsie

quotes.quote: If you do not have persistence then no amount of education, talent or genius can make up for it.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: It's no use saying, "We are doing our best."You have got to succeed in doing what is necessary.
quotes.author: Winston S. Churchill

quotes.quote: I haven't spent my time trying to duplicate my success. But only because I haven't had any yet.
quotes.author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

quotes.quote: Change is in the air. This change reminds us that we are made and beautifully sculpted by the same power that orchestrates the change of season. Let this be the season you embrace and align yourself with this change.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Participate in your own dreams, don't just say what you want or complain about what you don't have.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: The greater the loyalty of a group toward the group, the greater is the motivation among the members to achieve the goals of the group, and the greater the probability that the group will achieve its goals.
quotes.author: Rensis Likert

quotes.quote: Patience, persistence and perspiration make an unbeatable combination for success.
quotes.author: Napoleon Hill

quotes.quote: Life is a balanced system of learning and evolution. Whether pleasure or pain; every situation in your life serves a purpose. It is up to us to recognize what that purpose could be.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: Don't live to be judged for what you haven't done. Live to be judged for what you have done.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: What good has impatience ever brought? It has only served as the mother of mistakes and the father of irritation.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli

quotes.quote: I love 'Braxton Family Values!' I love seeing a strong family unit striving for success while dealing with everyday struggles like everyone else. Whatever drama they find themselves in, they find a way to solve it and get back to the importance of family. A positive show for sure.
quotes.author: Drew Sidora

quotes.quote: Free yourself from the complexities of your life! A life of simplicity and happiness awaits you.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: There is no try. There is only do.
quotes.author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

quotes.quote: I like Dancing of Indian girls more than my parents' prayers . Because they dance with love and passion . But my parents just say their prayers because they got used to it .
quotes.author: Ali Shariati

quotes.quote: Start with big dreams and make life worth living.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards

quotes.quote: How many a man has thrown up his hands at a time when a little more effort, a little more patience would have achieved success.
quotes.author: Elbert Hubbard

quotes.quote: You make mistakes, mistakes don't make you
quotes.author: Maxwell Maltz

quotes.quote: Stop lying to yourself. When we deny our own truth, we deny our own potential.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: Doing the tough things sets winners apart from losers.
quotes.author: Stephen Richards,  Cosmic Ordering: You can be successful

quotes.quote: It may take little time to get where you want to be, but if you pause and think for a moment, you will notice that you are no longer where you were. Do not stop--keep going.
quotes.author: Rodolfo Costa,  Advice My Parents Gave Me: and Other Lessons I Learned from My Mistakes

quotes.quote: ...If there is no risk, there is no reward.
quotes.author: Christy Raedeke,  The Daykeeper's Grimoire

quotes.quote: Success is a poor teacher
quotes.author: Robert T. Kiyosaki,  Cashflow Quadrant: Rich Dad's Guide to Financial Freedom

quotes.quote: Success is something you experience when you act accordingly. Success is not something you have, it's something you do.
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

quotes.quote: Do you love yourself enough to BE what you love yourself enough to WANT?
quotes.author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

quotes.quote: What I have achieved by industry and practice, anyone else with tolerable natural gift and ability can also achieve.
quotes.author: Johann Sebastian Bach
